Työt koostuvat pääasiassa rakennustelineiden ja sääsuojarakenteiden / sääsuojien asennus- ja purkutehtävistä. Telineasennusten lisäksi työhön sisältyy myös nostolava-auton kuljettaminen työkohteisiin ja työskentely nostokorista käsin konsoliasennustehtävissä. Työt tehdään ryhmässä tai asentajaparin kanssa. Työkohteet sijaitsevat Tampereella sekä ympäristökunnissa ja niihin tyypillisesti kuljetaan omalla autolla lukuun ottamatta konsoliasennuskohteita, joihin käytössä on em. nostolava-auto. Työntekijälle maksetaan TES:n mukainen korvaus päivittäisistä matkakustannuksista kotoa työkohteeseen sekä km-korvaus mahdollisista työkohteiden välisistä ajoista.

Työ on arkisin tehtävää päivätyötä klo 7:00 - 15:30, pääasiassa 40 h/vko. Työpäivien pituudessa voi esiintyä jonkin verran vaihtelua. Tehtävässä noudatetaan rakennusalan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaus kokemuksen / ammattiosaamisen mukaisesti.

jobs.title: Researcher in Solar Physics
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Researcher position at the Rosseland Centre for Solar Physics (RoCS) at the Institute of Theoretical Astrophysics (ITA).

The position is for a period of 2 years.

Starting date is flexible between 1st of January 2027 and 1st of October 2027.

Place of work is Rosseland Centre for Solar Physics, Institute of Theoretical Astrophysics at Blindern, Oslo.


Project description

The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway through the Researcher Project for Early Career Scientists (FRIPRO) “MultiSCORE: Multi-scale structure of the coronal environment” and led by Petra Kohutova. The MultiSCORE project focuses on the formation of large- and small-scale structure in the solar corona and combines high-resolution solar observations with numerical modelling. The successful candidate will contribute to the observational aspect of the project using multi-vantage-point observations of the solar corona from Solar Orbiter and the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO). The candidate will work on the analysis of fine-scale structure in the corona using Solar Orbiter/EUI imaging and SPICE spectroscopic data, and on reconstruction of three-dimensional structure of active regions by combining multi-vantage-point Solar Orbiter and SDO/AIA observations with constraints from magnetic field extrapolations. Observational results will be compared with synthetic observables from numerical models. The candidate will be expected to participate in the dissemination of the research results through journal publications and conference presentations in Solar Physics and Astrophysics as well as through outreach activities.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe's leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Solar Physics, Astrophysics, or a closely related field. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and completed defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
  • Experience with Solar Orbiter data analysis
  • Programming skills in Python/IDL/Julia

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience with scaling and intermittency analysis techniques applied to solar or space plasma observations and/or simulations is an advantage
  • Experience with coronal magnetic field extrapolation methods is an advantage

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 595 000 - 690 000 depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

We especially encourage women to apply.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • A short (1-2 page) research statement describing how the applicant’s expertise fits the project objectives and what additional ideas or research directions they could bring to the project
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates and academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

Please see Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

The Rosseland Centre for Solar Physics is situated at the Institute of Theoretical Astrophysics, the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences.

MISSION

Own the system and electronics engineering of a wearable airbag vest ECU, from architecture definition through industrialization and manufacturing release.

The role combines system engineering ownership and electronics design leadership for an existing product platform that will evolve across multiple generations, with increased functionality, connectivity, and performance.

The objective is to deliver safe, robust, manufacturable, and evolvable ECU solutions that meet functional, safety, cost, quality, and planning requirements for a critical safety application.

The role acts as the technical reference, working closely with the Project Manager, hardware and software teams, industrialization, suppliers, and validation teams. In addition, the System lead will be the main technical contact for the Product teams and will work on the integration with them. The team is located in France & Sweden mainly. Travel to France, China, US & other countries is expected regularly (Several times a year)

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

System & Product Architecture

    

Define, maintain, and evolve the ECU system architecture across generations (sensing, processing, power, safety interfaces, connectivity, updates)

    

Perform functional analysis including safety and cybersecurity

    

Define system modularity, interfaces, constraints, and services,

    

Ensure architectural consistency across hardware, embedded software, and connectivity (mobile gateway & cloud interfaces)

    

Own the technical roadmap for future product generations

Electronics Design Leadership

    

Lead and approve key electronics design choices (MCU/SoC, sensors, power architecture, connectivity modules, safety‑critical circuits)

    

Identify technical risks and design hard points and define mitigation actions

    

Validate design results with hardware and software leads

    

Ensure compliance with cost, power consumption, robustness, and environmental constraints specific to wearable products

Development Process, Safety & Compliance

    

Apply suitable systems engineering methods, e.g., following the V‑cycle

    

Ensure alignment with functional safety and quality processes

    

Lead or contribute to risk and safety analyses (DFMEA, PFMEA, hazard analysis)

    

Ensure full traceability from requirements to verification and validation

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
Lyten Sweden is seeking a professional and experienced Principal Engineer withing Manufacturing Engineering function. The Principal Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for defining, scaling, and optimizing manufacturing processes across one or multiple process areas. This role provides strategic direction, technical authority, and mentorship while driving the process development of next-generation battery technology.  The Principal Engineer leads complex, high-impact initiatives from concept through industrialization, including process design, equipment strategy, and factory integration. Acting as a key interface between R&D, operations, quality, and external partners, the role ensures robust, scalable, and cost-efficient manufacturing solutions that support production ramp-up and long-term operational excellence. In addition to hands-on technical contribution, the Principal Engineer establishes engineering standards, drives cross-site alignment, and shapes the technology roadmap for manufacturing processes.



Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Strategy

    Define and own process technology strategy and roadmap for assigned manufacturing areas.

    Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) and technical authority across multiple process domains.

    Establish engineering standards, best practices, and design guidelines across the organization.

    Drive alignment between R&D, manufacturing, and supply chain to ensure scalable process development.

Process & Equipment Development

    Lead the development of advanced process and equipment specifications for new and existing manufacturing systems.

    Identify, evaluate, and select strategic equipment suppliers and technology partners.

    Oversee and lead design reviews with equipment suppliers, ensuring technical rigor and scalability.

    Provide guidance and oversight for process development from pilot through high-volume production.

Program & Project Leadership

    Lead large-scale, complex equipment and process development projects with significant business impact.

    Guide cross-functional project teams through all phases: concept, design, FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and ramp-up.

    Act as escalation point for critical technical challenges across projects and sites.

Equipment Lifecycle Management

    Provide leadership and governance for installation, commissioning, and validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) of manufacturing equipment.

    Ensure lifecycle strategies are in place for equipment reliability, maintainability, and performance optimization.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

    Identify and lead high-impact continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and other methodologies.

    Drive improvements in yield, throughput, cost, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

    Establish and track process capability metrics and KPIs across production lines and sites.

Troubleshooting & Advanced Problem Solving

    Lead complex root cause analysis (RCA) efforts, including 8D and A3 methodologies, for critical process or equipment failures.

Data Analysis & Digitalization

    Leverage Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), advanced analytics, and statistical tools to monitor performance and drive optimization.

Governance & Documentation

jobs.title: Senior Immersion Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a naval architect, maritime engineer or offshore engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbor (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As an Immersion Engineer, you will participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In the first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In the second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, assisting the Immersion Master by giving technical advice.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

  • During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

  • You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

  • You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands

  • You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

  • You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

  • You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

  • During float up and ballasting you check if the operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

  • During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations.

  • You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

  • After immersion, you will do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

  • You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

  • You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

  • You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

  • You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

  • You are a team player with strong communication skills

  • You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

  • You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

jobs.title: ROSKILDE: THATCHERS WANTED – A BAD HAIR DAY IS ACTUALLY PART OF THE JOB
jobs.description:
ROSKILDE: THATCHERS WANTED – A BAD HAIR DAY IS ACTUALLY PART OF THE JOB

Straw in your hair.

Straw on your clothes.

Straw in places you didn’t even know straw could get into.

But at the end of the day, you’ll have a thatched roof you can look at and be proud of.

We are looking for several skilled thatchers to work on thatched roofs in and around Roskilde.

A CRAFT YOU CAN ACTUALLY SEE

Your working day will revolve around thatching and thatched roofs.

You’ll work on a variety of tasks within the trade, where craftsmanship, precision and attention to the finished result really matter.

Because there’s one slightly unforgiving thing about a thatched roof:

It’s pretty difficult to hide a poor finish behind a sheet of plasterboard.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

There are two ways you could be a good fit:

You have relevant training or qualifications

or

You have hands-on experience with thatching.

The important thing is that you know the trade and are able to contribute from day one.

In addition:

✔ A Category B driving licence is required
✔ A BE driving licence is a plus
✔ You can work independently
✔ You take pride and responsibility in your craftsmanship
✔ You have an eye for quality and a good finish
✔ You’re comfortable with your workplace being a little higher up than the car park

A COMPANY VEHICLE CAN BE PROVIDED

So there’s no need to turn your own car into a combination of toolbox, storage unit and hay bale.

If you want to work in a trade where quality craftsmanship is still done by hand – and can be admired from a distance, we’d like to hear from you.

And no...

jobs.title: Flere BPA-assistenter søkes til ung jente – fast 100 % og mindre stillinger
jobs.description:
Vil du bli min BPA-assistent?

Hei! Jeg er en snart 19 år gammel jente som bor i Kvæfjord kommune. Jeg går på videregående skole og ønsker å leve et aktivt, sosialt og selvstendig liv – slik som andre på min alder. Jeg er veldig glad i dyr, og hjemme hos meg er det både hund og katt.

På grunn av en varig funksjonsnedsettelse har jeg behov for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, og nå søker jeg flere trygge og engasjerte assistenter til teamet mitt.

Arbeidssted, stillinger og arbeidstid

  • Arbeidsstedet ligger sentralt i Kvæfjord og er lett tilgjengelig med bil fra Harstad, Evenes og omkringliggende områder.
  • Jeg søker primært assistenter i faste 100 % stillinger, men mindre stillingsprosenter kan også være aktuelt.
  • Jeg har behov for assistenter på dagtid, kveld og natt, og det finnes derfor flere muligheter for ulike turnusløsninger. Det kan være aktuelt å jobbe langvakter, nattevakter eller en kombinasjon av ulike vakttyper.
  •  Jeg søker også tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved behov.

Nærmere informasjon om konkrete vakttider og turnus gis i forbindelse med intervju.

Hva går jobben ut på?

Som assistent skal du hjelpe meg med det jeg trenger for å få hverdagen til å fungere, og for å kunne leve livet slik jeg selv ønsker.

Arbeidsoppgavene kan blant annet være:

  • Praktisk bistand i hjemmet
  • Hjelp med daglige gjøremål
  • Bli med på avtaler, aktiviteter og sosiale sammenkomster
  • Bidra til en trygg, aktiv og selvstendig hverdag
  • Samarbeide med resten av BPA-teamet mitt

Arbeidsdagene vil være varierte. Noen dager kan være rolige, mens andre er mer aktive og innholdsrike. Det viktigste er at du klarer å tilpasse deg, og er en trygg og stabil person i hverdagen min.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg håper å finne deg som er trygg, omsorgsfull og til å stole på. Du trives med å hjelpe andre, samtidig som du respekterer meg, mine ønsker og måten jeg ønsker å leve livet mitt på.

Det er en fordel om du:

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert
  • Trives med å samarbeide, men også jobbe selvstendig
  • Tar initiativ der det er naturlig
  • Er stabil og ønsker å bli værende i jobben over tid
  • Har førerkort klasse B
  • Snakker og forstår norsk godt
  • Ikke har allergier, men tåler både hund og katt

Det viktigste er at vi har god kjemi, og at jeg føler meg trygg sammen med deg. Du trenger ikke å ha jobbet som BPA-assistent tidligere, da du vil få god opplæring og oppfølging.

Hos meg får du:

  • En variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag
  • God opplæring og tett oppfølging
  • Et godt og inkluderende BPA-team

Lønn og arbeidsvilkår etter tariff: Landsoverenskomsten for BPA og Virke.

Oppstart: Snarest!

Har du lyst på en jobb der du kan gjøre en viktig forskjell i hverdagen min?

Da håper jeg å høre fra deg!

Søknader behandles fortløpende!


Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Hoitaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Sipooseen
jobs.description:
Hoiva-avustaja sympaattiselle ruotsinkieliselle seniorille

Haemme ruotsinkieltä osaavaa hoiva-avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista senioriasiakastamme Sipoossa. Etsimme myös hoitajaa avustamaan muita asiakkaitamme.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

Mitä hoitaja-helpperi tekee?

Hoitaja-helpperi on sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutettu henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle ikäihmiselle. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.

Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:

suihkuapua voinnin tarkkailua kotona pärjäämisen tukemista liikkumisessa tukemista

Lisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.

Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?

Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?

Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus hoitaja-helpperiksi täällä.

Lue lisää Hembystä klikkaamalla tästä.

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää hoitaja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Site Engineer, Mechanical for Renewables; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Aarhus, Worldwide
jobs.description:
If you are as passionate about sustainability and the green transition as we are, then this is a great opportunity for you to join an international company in growth as our new Site Engineer, Mechanical for our Renewables Division!
 
Your position 

As our new Site Engineer, Mechanical at Semco Maritime you will join an experienced, highly skilled and passionate team of engineers in our Renewables division. This team has been responsible for creating one of the largest project portfolios within offshore substations worldwide.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 
We are working on sites globally in our markets, including Europe, Asia and the USA. So, traveling work is the standard and we work both offshore and onshore.

Your tasks & responsibilities 

You will be involved in the construction of offshore substation for windfarms and distribution/transmission projects world-wide. You, together with your team will be responsible for installations, tests, and commissioning of mechanical systems such as ventilation systems, cooling systems, fire extinguishing system, diesel generator system and fuel system.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 

  • Coordinating and managing daily site activities for 4-10 skilled workers
  • Ensuring that the project activities adhere to the schedule and activities are planned accordingly
  • Coordinate and plan with installation suppliers / yard / partners
  • Purchase and overseeing the timely delivery of materials and coordination with vendors
  • Plan and align with Engineering department on changes in design and/or other topics
  • Ad-hoc daily tasks and problem solving
  • Run and manage start-up and commissioning of mechanical systems

Your profile & qualifications 

We imagine that you are an ambitious and talented professional with a keen eye for detail. You are also a dedicated team player with a positive attitude as well as good commercial awareness and managerial skills.
 
To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Preferred to have a master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, marine engineering or similar
  • Have prior hands-on experience with some of the mechanical systems
  • Have experience working with staff and supplier contracts
  • Possess a safety-first mindset
  • Would like to work in an international setting where a lot of traveling is required to go to the sites
  • Have effective interpersonal skills and great communication skills in English

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 
Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  
We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   
Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: 100% Pedagogisk Leder (Okt 2026 - Juli 2027)

jobs.description:
Pedagogisk leder

Hva vi ser etter

Teacher qualification requirements:

"(Please note applicants will only be considered if they meet all the requirements)"

  • Must have a bachelors in Early Years Education or similar

  • A Foreign education degree must be recognised by the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (Hk-dir) as comparable to achieve qualified preschool teacher status in Norway. Documentation from HK-dir must be provided.

  • English Fluency (min. B2 proficiency)

  • Provide a police background check from your home country and any country you have resided in for 6+ months in the last 10 years. Police background checks must be no more than 3 months old and can be presented prior to appointment.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Contributes to an environment of safety and in which every child can flourish

  • Conducts oneself professionally, operating at all times in line with ISB's Core Values, policies, and procedures

  • Demonstrates a willingness to communicate openly, calmly, and professionally as part of the ISB team

  • Will be an active, positive participant in collaborative planning and meetings

  • Will be willing and comfortable to work with all age groups in the ECC

Arbeidsoppgaver

A teacher in the ECC is expected to:

  • Ensure that all pedagogical work in the classroom is in accordance with Kindergarten Act, the Norwegian Framework Plan, and the IB-program.

  • The pedagogical leader/homeroom teacher will lead the work in their classroom with a focus on planning, implementation, documentation, and assessment by:

    • Monitoring and reporting student progress

      • Observe and track each child's progress, creating reports to share with parents and guardians

      • Maintain regular, open, and positive communication with parents about their child's development

      • Collaborate with other staff members to ensure the child's best interests are prioritized

      • Utilize the appropriate reporting channels and practices we have within the school (e.g., student incident reports, §42 Aktivitetsplikt, etc).

    • Facilitating parental cooperation through

      • Weekly updates documenting learning experiences

      • Daily dialogue with parents at drop off and pick up times

      • Parent-teacher conferences

      • Mutual trust built on positive communication

    • Building positive relationships with children

      • Ensure that all children feel safe, seen, heard and cared for

      • Focus on physical and emotional well-being

      • Promote agency

  • Develop and implement age and stage appropriate lesson plans and daily routines to foster social, emotional, and academic growth through creative, hands-on, and play-based activities

    • Create a safe, positive, inclusive, and warm learning and play environment, prioritizing the best interests of the children while promoting agency and play

    • Use play, stories, and games to promote well-being and all-round development as set forth by the Norwegian Framework Plan Chapter 9: Learning areas

  • Effectively manage a classroom

    • Ensure the classroom is clean, organized, and safe, adhering to all health and safety regulations

    • Monitor children to ensure their safety, promote good behavior, and encourage social skills and independence

    • Supervise children during all activities, ensuring the best interests of all children are always prioritized

    • Supervise other employees in the classroom and ensure they are also contributing to a safe and good learning and play environment, adhering to expectations for all ECC staff

  • Attend and participate in planning day meetings.

    • Participate in staff meetings and ongoing professional development to stay current on best practices in early childhood education

    • Contribute to the ECC's joint change and development work regarding the annual plan of the ECC and the Supervision Activity Plan

  • Adhere to ISB's Child Protection Policy and procedures

    • Understand role as a mandated reporter
Vi tilbyr

We are offering:

  • an inspiring international work environment

  • an active workplace where we see, listen to, and encourage each other

  • professional and personal development

  • a workplace that follows the school calendar and closures of ISB

  • salary according to the PBL salary scale

The working hours for preschool teachers are 37,5 hours per week. Pre-School Teachers (Non Pedagogical Leaders) are entitled to 6 hours per week of non-contact time used for team collaboration meetings and planning.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

ISB is a co-educational private day school which is authorized to deliver the International Baccalaureate PYP and MYP programmes. The school currently enrolls approximately 250 students from more than 30 nations and is experiencing expanding enrollment.

ISB Early Childhood Center (ECC) encompasses four preschool classrooms (two toddler groups and two preschool groups) which make up the first five years of education at ISB. A high staff to student ratio is maintained for this age group of 1-to-5 year olds. We provide an inclusive, safe and inspiring learning and play environment, through organizing our students in small groups where the individual child has a voice. We currently have 45 students in the ECC

jobs.title: Matkailuautomekaanikko / asunto osan korjaaja S-Caravan, Helsinki Pitäjänmäki
jobs.description:
**Etsimme ammattitaitoista matkailuautomekaanikkoa vahvistamaan S-Caravanin tiimiä Helsingin Pitäjänmäkeen.**

Haemme henkilöä, jolla on kokemusta matkailuautojen asunto-osan huolto- ja korjaustöistä ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti erilaisten vikojen, korjausten ja asennusten parissa.

Työ on monipuolista ja vaihtelee pienistä huolto ja korjaustöistä vaativampaan vianetsintään ja kokonaisuuksien korjaamiseen.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat esimerkiksi:

- matkailuautojen asunto osan huolto ja korjaustyöt

- sähköjärjestelmien vianetsintä ja korjaukset

- lämmitys-, vesi- ja kaasujärjestelmiin liittyvät huolto ja korjaustyöt

- jääkaappien, lämmittimien, vesipumppujen ja muiden matkailuauton laitteiden vianetsintä ja korjaaminen

- ikkunoiden, luukkujen, ovien ja muiden asunto osan rakenteiden korjaukset

- kalusteiden ja sisärakenteiden korjaus ja asennustyöt

- lisävarusteiden ja tarvikkeiden asennukset

- kosteusvaurioihin ja rakenteisiin liittyvät korjaustyöt osaamisesi mukaan

- takuukorjaukset ja valmistajien teknisten ohjeiden mukaiset työt

- muut matkailuautojen asunto osaan liittyvät huolto ja korjaustyöt


Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Toivomme sinulta ennen kaikkea käytännön kokemusta matkailuautojen, matkailuvaunujen tai vastaavien ajoneuvojen asunto osan tekniikasta.

Arvostamme:

- kokemusta matkailuautojen huolto ja korjaustöistä

- hyvää teknistä ongelmanratkaisukykyä

- sähkö ja vianetsintäosaamista

- huolellista ja järjestelmällistä työskentelytapaa

- kykyä tehdä töitä itsenäisesti

- vastuullista suhtautumista työn laatuun

- halua oppia ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa


Aikaisempi kokemus matkailuautojen määräaikaishuolloista, alustan huolloista tai muista ajoneuvotekniikan korjaustöistä **katsotaan eduksi, mutta niitä ei edellytetä**.

Myös kokemus esimerkiksi Fiat Ducato -pohjaisista matkailuautoista, Truma, Alde, Dometic tai muista matkailuajoneuvojen järjestelmistä katsotaan eduksi.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- vakituisen ja monipuolisen työn kasvavalla matkailuautoalalla

- mahdollisuuden keskittyä nimenomaan matkailuautojen huoltoon ja korjaukseen

- nykyaikaiset korjaamotilat ja työvälineet

- monipuolisen asiakaskannan ja erilaisia matkailuautomerkkejä

- mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi valmistajien koulutusten ja teknisten järjestelmien kautta

- osaavan työyhteisön tuen

- vastuuta ja mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työn tekemiseen

- kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan


S-Caravan / S-Autohuolto huoltaa ja korjaa matkailuautoja kokonaisvaltaisesti. Pitäjänmäen toimipisteemme toimii myös valtuutettuna huoltopisteenä tunnetuille matkailuautomerkeille, joten työssä pääset tekemään myös valmistajien takuukorjauksia ja työskentelemään teknisten järjestelmien sekä tehdasohjeiden parissa.

jobs.title: Global Credit Manager
jobs.description:
Company description:

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

Job description:



   What you will do  

As a Global Credit Manager, you will be responsible for competence development through ongoing development and maintenance of global credit training and credit review processes.



Your starting point will be to, together with your colleagues at VFS and in the broad cross-functional network at the Volvo Group, take responsibility in the following areas for your assigned markets/regions:



•    Coordinates VFS credit review process for transactions that exceed the regional or market authority.•    Make credit decisions up to their agreed delegated authority and make recommendations on deals exceeding their authority.•    Conducts reviews of underwriting quality in local markets, reports findings to SVP Credit and Risk as well as Region SVPs within VFS•    Performs the role Secretary of Executive Credit Committee (ECC) for VFS when deals from your region are heard.•    Monitors and closes outstanding follow-up items from ECC decisions•    Reports on ECC activity, including approval rates, outstanding conditions, and declines by market, credit grade, and brand•    Assist the Global Credit Director with the administration and management of the two SharePoint sites owned by HQ Credit & Risk (ECC SharePoint and HQ Credit & Risk)•    Assist in the ongoing reporting related to Group Credit Exception frame, Top 15 retail and wholesale accounts and watchlist.•    Leads development of presentation materials for Group Credit Exception transactions should the need occur•    Develop and update presentations to AB Volvo for transactions exceeding VFS credit authority•    Support the review process and provide recommendations for updates to the VFS global credit directives•    Ensures VFS compliance with AB Volvo credit policy & regional compliance with VFS global credit directives•    Supports the markets in credit, deal, and financial product questions as well as share insights on activities, or strategies that could benefit local credit or collections activities. •    Actively manages VFS portfolio through participation in portfolio reviews•    Reviews of findings in periodic risk reporting•    Assist in the ongoing development and maintenance of global credit and risk training.•    Provides back up to the other regions/markets if their assigned Global Credit Manager/Director is out.•    Models The Volvo Way and ensure The Code of Conduct is followed•    Other duties and projects may be assignedYour future teamYou will report directly to the SVP, Credit and Risk In VFS, we demonstrate a clear vision to continue Transforming Together, a global mindset and a proven track record of successfully developing people, teams, culture, and leadership.

     Who are you?  

Do you dream big? We do too, and we are excited to grow together. In this role, we believe it is the right mindset that will make a difference at VFS. If you, besides your genuine interest in working with people in Transforming Together, also have a positive, service-oriented, and collaborative mindset, and take a proactive approach to handling all responsibilities, idea generation, and recommendations for productivity and efficiency - then we would welcome you to apply for this role.  



Qualifications likely required to be successful in this role include:



•    BA/BS in Business or related field, MBA highly preferred•    7+ years of experience in Credit/Risk •    2+ years of significant experience in large transaction underwriting preferred•    Proven record of sound underwriting decisions•    Significant experience understanding the customer finance origination processes•    Strong understanding of VFS collection and large-customer workout procedures•    Experience in drafting/maintaining policies and directives •    Demonstrated ability to build productive business relationships and achieve consensus •    Proven ability to work cross functionally•    Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams SharePoint and Outlook.   Strong Excel skills required, including data analysis, reporting and presentation of insights•    Experience working with business intelligence and reporting tools, such as Microsoft Power BI (would be a plus) to analyze portfolio performance, credit trends and risk metrics.•    Ability to work independently, exercise sound business judgment, and manage multiple transactions in a fast paced, demanding environment•    Exceptional presentation skills with considerable experience in various business settings•    Fluency in reading, writing and speaking English; additional languages a plus

     Ready for the next move?  

If you want to make a real impact in your career, Volvo Financial Services is where you want to be. We look forward to meeting you. Last Application Date: Friday September 18th 2026 Hiring Manager: Renee Hiner, SVP Credit & RiskPeople & Culture Partner: Sandra Smith

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel Environment- Volvo Group
jobs.description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your legal expertise to help shape the future of sustainable transport and contribute to solutions that move the world forward. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, enjoy working close to the business, and want to be part of a highly collaborative team with real impact, this could be the opportunity for you.  



We are looking for a talented Senior Legal Counsel focusing on environmental law to strengthen dedicated legal support for industrial projects and ongoing operations in the Trucks Technology and Industrial Division. In this role, you will be a trusted legal partner across key value chains and contribute to strategic decision-making in a fast-moving, international environment. If you are looking for a role where you can combine legal expertise with strategy, collaboration and business impact, we would like to hear from you. Apply now!



About the Role



As Senior Legal Counsel Environmental in the Trucks Technology and Industrial Division, you will help strengthen legal support for industrial projects and ongoing operations. You will work closely with stakeholders in technology, purchasing, and operations and be part of the TTI Legal & Volvo Group IP function and the Legal Value Chain Functions team, with legal colleagues on different sites. Your primary focus will be project- and operations-related environmental legal topics, but the role will also offer the opportunity to be involved in a broader range of legal topics such as construction and project related agreements, commercial agreements and regulatory compliance.  



In this role, you will collaborate closely with leaders and business colleagues across the organization, as well as with legal and IP colleagues within the function and Volvo Group. The role offers both responsibility and freedom within your area, with the opportunity to influence decisions early and support the business through the full value chain. You will work in an environment where legal matters are closely connected to business reality, and where your advice helps enable progress, safeguard the business, and support long-term success.



Key Responsibilities in this role, you will:




    Provide proactive, business-oriented legal support to the Trucks Technology and Industrial Division in larger industrial projects and running business  
    Independently provide clear, pragmatic legal advice with a focus on the environmental law area such as permitting matters and authority interactions  
    Draft, review and negotiate construction, project and other agreements  
    Instruct and coordinate external legal resources  
    Work closely with leadership and key stakeholders and contribute with clear, pragmatic, and commercially sound legal guidance  
    Take ownership of your assigned area while being anctive and valued member of the team



Qualifications and Experience.

  



  

We believe you are a qualified lawyer with 8+ years of experience from an in-house legal role or a law firm, ideally with exposure to international business environments. You are curious, confident, and motivated by working closely with the business. You understand the value of legal advice that is not only correct, but also practical, clear, and supportive of the bigger picture. To succeed in this role, you are likely to bring:




    Solid experience in environmental law and a willingness to grow outside this field as well. Experience in construcion legal matters is a merit.  

  






    Strong interest in purchasing, technology, and operations  

  






    Strong ability to work in larger projects  

  






    Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills  

  






    Experience of or interest in working in a global manufacturing end-to-end environment  

  






    The ability to build trust and collaborate effectively across functions  

  






    A proactive and accountable mindset  

  






    Strong analytical and communication skills.  

  





Experience from a law firm is welcome, especially if you are ready to move closer to the business and take on a broader responsibility.

jobs.title: Senior Research Adviser for EU, International Funding, Innovation and Impact, Faculty of Health Sciences
jobs.description:
Are you curious about how FP10 will change the opportunities and requirements facing universities? Are you interested in the growing expectations for innovation and impact arising from research? And would you like to work both strategically and closely with researchers and projects, with one clear objective: to strengthen SUND’s international position and secure more external funding?

Then you could play a central role in SUND Research Support. We are looking for an experienced research adviser who from 1 December 2026 can serve as our key specialist for EU and international funding opportunities – and help prepare the unit for tomorrow’s requirements in relation to funding, project delivery, innovation and societal impact.

Responsibilities
You will take an overview of EU and international funding: from developments in Horizon Europe and FP10 to specific calls, partnerships and opportunities for SUND researchers. You will translate policy and programme developments into action and help us position ourselves early as new agendas emerge.

The role spans strategic intelligence and portfolio oversight through to hands-on advice and coordination of prioritised initiatives. Some days you will work on long-term EU positioning and pipeline development; on others, closely with a researcher, an international consortium or a specific call. We do not expect you to do everything yourself, but you will need to spot opportunities, bring together the right expertise and drive progress.

Innovation and impact are important parts of the role. You will strengthen our impact-upfront approach and ensure that requirements relating to involvement, uptake, implementation and knowledge valorisation are considered early. At the same time, you will contribute to a smooth transition from pre-award to post-award, so that project delivery is considered from the outset and lessons from funded projects and project implementation feed into new applications.

You will be both a key contributor to specific EU and international initiatives and a co-developer of our shared models, workflows and portfolio overview. The aim is a more coherent approach to international funding – not simply more individual applications.

Qualifications
We are looking for an experienced professional who thrives at the intersection of research, EU policy, funding, innovation and impact. You have solid experience of EU or international funding, research development or research support, and a good knowledge of Horizon Europe or other major international programmes.

You work strategically and analytically but are also keen to turn insight into tangible results. You are a strong coordinator and relationship-builder who can navigate complex processes, bring together expertise and build trust with researchers, colleagues and management. You communicate confidently in both Danish and English.
It is an advantage if you also have experience of areas such as EU policy, international consortia, Brussels networks, post-award, innovation, societal impact or knowledge valorisation. We do not expect you to be an expert in all of these areas. A PhD or other research experience may be an advantage but is not essential.

In addition, you have an understanding of and a desire to work with digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI) in relation to optimizing processes and creating value within the organization. 

About SUND Research Support and the Faculty of Health Sciences
SUND Research Support assists researchers at the Faculty of Health Sciences at SDU from the early idea and funding opportunity through to application, project delivery, innovation and impact.

We aim to work more proactively with funding intelligence, positioning, partnerships and long-term pipelines – and to create stronger links between pre-award, post-award, innovation and impact. At the same time, we want to use data, organisational learning and AI more systematically.

You will have the opportunity both to work directly with researchers and projects and to help shape how a modern research support function should operate in the years ahead. You will play a central role in SUND’s international funding activities in the run-up to FP10 and help create stronger links between EU/international funding, post-award, innovation and impact.

You will work closely with strong health sciences research environments, management teams and colleagues with a range of specialist profiles. We are interested in new ways of working and in how data, digital tools and AI can add value to research support. This is an opportunity both to deliver results today and to help shape how we work tomorrow.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.
As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

Read more about the Faculty of Health Sciences here.

Contact
If you would like more information about the position, you are welcome to contact head of SUND Research Support Anne Kathrine Overgaard, tlf. 60111043, e-mail: aovergaard@health.sdu.dk or Head of Education and Secretariat Merete Munk på mmunk@health.sdu.dk.

Application Process
The application deadline is 29 September 2026 at 11:59 PM. We expect to conduct interviews 7 October 2026. 

Employment starts on 1 December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Salary and Terms of Employment
Your place of employment will be the University of Southern Denmark in Odense, Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

There may be limited travel activity to other SDU campus cities.

Employment is in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and collective agreement for academics (AC).

The position is full time.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range of the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

If you are interested in the position, you must submit an application that includes a cover letter, CV indicating months and years (without photo), and diploma. All documents related to the application should not contain photos or CPR numbers – if so, the CPR number must be redacted.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. The cover letter and CV must not exceed 5 MB.

Guidance on the application process can be found here.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified applicants, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About SDU
The University of Southern Denmark exists to create value for and with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we aim to make a positive difference for society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talent. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. It is the university’s researchers, teachers, students, leaders, and technical-administrative staff who form the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers lower fees, greater transparency, and a radically improved experience.

We’re not just building another investment service — we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.

A quick note: This is not a traditional hiring process. While we're not actively looking to fill an immediate vacancy, we're always interested in meeting exceptional people who can help shape SAVR's future. If there's a strong mutual fit, we're open to exploring opportunities together

The Role – AI Engineer

As an AI Engineer with backend skills in our cross-functional team, you’ll join our tech team in Stockholm or Halmstad to build AI-powered product experiences end-to-end. You’ll work closely with fellow Software Engineers, Product Designers, and Product Managers to ship LLM-driven features such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, intelligent assistants, and automation, built for reliability, security, and great UX.

Our Tech Team Lead will manage and support your work, while reporting directly to our VP of Engineering. A glimpse into our tech stack: Python, SQL, Terraform, hosted on AWS, plus an AI stack that includes LLM APIs/open-source models, vector databases/similarity search, retrieval pipelines, evaluation tooling, and observability for production AI.

Your Mission

    

Build and ship LLM-powered product features (RAG, assistants, semantic search).

    

Productionize AI systems with guardrails, monitoring, evals, and cost/latency control.

    

Partner with product/design/engineering to turn use cases into measurable outcomes.

    

Build and maintain key platform features, APIs, and services, prioritizing scalability, reliability, and top-tier performance.

    

Provide direction and strategic insight on data related topics.

Additionally you will

    

Drive ideas and develop concepts from a tech perspective.

    

Explore ideas iteratively and refine them into production-quality solutions.

    

Contribute to improving the architecture, tech stack, and operational methods.

    

Improve our AI development workflow to support safe and reliable production AI.

    

Follow and promote good engineering practices to deliver high-quality products.

    

Engage in code reviews and foster a culture of continuous learning through constructive feedback.

    

Be a positive force for our team culture.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You...

    

4+ years of professional team-based software development experience, with at least some experience building ML/AI-powered features or systems in production.

    

Experience working with scalable, product-based environments, where you’ve shipped user-facing features and care about latency, reliability, and real-world constraints.

    

Solid understanding of backend systems and data modeling, enough to build reliable text retrieval, integrate with existing services, and reason about data quality, privacy, and access control in AI workflows.

    

Passion for applied AI, including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, LLM evaluation, fine-tuning, and model serving.

    

Strong collaboration skills and an open-minded approach to exchanging ideas.

    

Fluent in English and a team player who values diverse perspectives.

    

Swedish citizen or valid EU work permits (we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role).

We’re seeking a motivated engineer with a broad skill set and a passion for applied AI, especially LLM-powered products, retrieval, and production-grade AI systems. You are someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is eager to contribute to building something great.

Our Cultural DNA

At SAVR, we’re:

🧠 Open-minded – we embrace new ideas, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning

🚀 Bold – we take smart risks, move fast, and aren’t afraid to fail forward

🤝 Honest – we value transparency, feedback, and doing the right thing

We’re a startup, so things can be a little messy — and that’s part of the thrill. If you thrive in building as a team and handling uncertainty, you will fit right in.

What’s In It for You

You’ll join a product- and design-driven company where your work has real impact. We keep things lean, move fast, and genuinely care about the experience we deliver — for customers and for each other.

Here’s what we offer:

💻 Top-tier work gear

💰 Competitive salary

🏃‍♀️ Generous wellness allowance

🤒 Insurance package

🌱 Occupational pension and long-term savings support

🏢 Office-first approach to foster collaboration and quick decision-making — with flexibility when you need it (4+1)

🥗 Stocked pantry, plus regular social gatherings and wellness activities to keep energy and culture high

Our Commitment to Diversity

SAVR is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We believe diverse teams build better products and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

Ready to Join Us?

We’d love to hear from you. Apply now or reach out with any questions — and let’s build something meaningful together.

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professorship at the Hans Christian Andersen Centre with a Focus on Digital Humanities, Textual Genesis and Nineteenth-Century Literature
jobs.description:
A five-year tenure-track assistant professorship is available at the Hans Christian Andersen Centre, Department for the Study of Culture and Language, University of Southern Denmark, with appointment from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The Hans Christian Andersen Centre is an internationally leading research environment within Andersen studies. Its research encompasses literary, cultural and public dissemination-oriented approaches to Andersen’s works, life and cultural significance. The Centre conducts research at the highest international level with the aim of developing new literary, cultural and dissemination-oriented perspectives on Andersen’s complete artistic oeuvre. The Centre provides a framework for collaboration with Danish and international researchers, cultural mediators and other actors in the field.

Job Content
The assistant professorship is a tenure-track position with a view to obtaining a permanent appointment as associate professor following a positive academic assessment.

The position is affiliated with the project Hans Christian Andersen’s Fairy Tales and Stories – the Digital Manuscript Edition and will, in close interaction with the project’s existing research activities, contribute to integrating digital, philological and literary approaches.

The assistant professor will be part of the Centre’s research environment and collaborate with the project’s editorial group, with responsibility for developing research at the intersection of digital humanities, textual genesis and literary-historical analysis.

Read more about the position here

jobs.title: Passioneret køkkenchef søges til Den Bette Kro
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at stå i spidsen for et klassisk dansk køkken og et ungt, passioneret team? Og samtidig have branchens måske bedste arbejdstider? Så er her en sjælden mulighed.

Om os

Den Bette Kro ligger midt i Aalborg og har fokus på det gode klassiske danske køkken. Vi laver meget smørrebrød, men også klassiske lune retter. Fælles for vores mad er, at den laves fra bunden af gode råvarer med kvalitet i højsædet.

Vi lægger stor vægt på både høj kvalitet til vores gæster og et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vores medarbejdere trives.

Den Bette Kro er en del af en koncern sammen med Cafe Vi.2 og Restaurant Det Tredje Sted.

Om jobbet

Som køkkenchef på Den Bette Kro står du i spidsen for køkkenet, både i forhold til den daglige service, hvor du selv er en del af den, samt drift og planlægning. Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med kvalitetssikring, udvikling og ledelse af køkkenets øvrige medarbejdere.

Det er vigtigt for os, at du er passioneret omkring ledelsesdelen, da du får en vigtig rolle i at styre driften på daglig basis. Du skal være med til at sætte retningen og sikre en ensartet høj kvalitet af maden.

Vi har et godt menukort, men der er altid plads til udvikling. Derudover har vi månedens smørrebrød, som skal tilpasses hver måned, samt selskaber, hvor der skal udvælges klassiske retter, og hvor du får ansvaret for at sikre kvaliteten.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Daglig ledelse og koordinering af køkkenet

  • Deltagelse i den daglige service

  • Drift og planlægning

  • Kvalitetssikring af mad og råvarer

  • Udvikling af månedens smørrebrød

  • Udvælgelse og kvalitetssikring af retter til selskaber

  • Ledelse og udvikling af køkkenets medarbejdere

  • Sikre struktur, godt flow og høj kvalitet i køkkenet

Om dig

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Er uddannet kok, smørrebrødsjomfru eller lignende

  • Gerne har erfaring fra en lignende stilling

  • Går forrest og viser vejen

  • Er passioneret omkring ledelse og godt køkkenhåndværk

  • Trives i et travlt miljø

  • Er god til at bevare overblikket og den gode tone – også når der er travlt

  • Er en god kollega, der bidrager positivt til fællesskabet

Vi kan tilbyde

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Rullende vagtplan

  • Fast fri om søndagen, da vi har lukket

  • Køkkenlukketid kl. 16.00 om lørdagen

  • Fri hver anden weekend i fast rul

  • Et sundt og positivt arbejdsmiljø med godt humør

  • Et ungt og energisk team, som allerede er godt oplært

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og arbejdsglæde

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til info@bettekro.dk.

Eventuelle spørgsmål kan rettes til Mads (restaurantchef) på telefon 98 31 90 00 (Den Bette Kro).

jobs.title: Area Business Manager People
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As Area Business Manager for the People area, you will hold overall business responsibility for how our people processes, services, data and technology capabilities are shaped, prioritised and developed, ensuring they continuously support business needs and create value across the organisation. Working in close co-leadership with the Area Tech Manager, you will connect people, process and technology needs to set a clear direction, develop scalable solutions and deliver measurable business value. You will also have formal people responsibility, leading and developing colleagues in the area while creating the conditions for strong collaboration, ownership and delivery. This is a forward-looking role in an area where we are still shaping the future, with the opportunity to bring a modern, relevant and creative perspective to how people solutions are designed, prioritised and brought to life.  

You will:

    Co-lead the People area together with the Area Tech Manager, ensuring clear direction, shared priorities and strong alignment between business and technology.  
    Hold overall responsibility for the area’s development and performance, beyond individual transformation initiatives.  
    Set a clear direction for how the People area supports colleagues, managers and HR teams across the organisation.  
    Turn business and people needs into clear priorities, plans and actions that create value in everyday work.  
    Lead improvements across the employee journey, making our people processes, services and tools easier to use, more reliable and more effective.  
    Work closely with People, Tech and market teams to connect real business needs with practical solutions that can scale across the organisation.  
    Make thoughtful choices on what to focus on first, balancing colleague experience, compliance, capacity, cost and long-term impact.  
    Create alignment between different teams and stakeholders, helping them work together towards shared outcomes.  
    Ensure the area is run responsibly, with clear ownership of resources, budgets, risks and continuous improvement.  
    Lead and develop people in the area through formal people responsibility, creating a collaborative, inclusive and forward-looking environment where teams can do their best work.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will work in close co-leadership with the Area Tech Manager, combining business and technology perspectives to set direction, align priorities and create value across the People area. Together, you will collaborate with the wider Area Tech team and process teams across the People Life Cycle to build simple, scalable and future-ready solutions shaped by real business needs and supporting the full employee journey.



WHO YOU ARE

We know that relevant experience can take different forms. What matters is that you understand the complexity of working across people, process and technology, and that you are motivated by building something better in a fast moving environment where priorities can change. You are comfortable stepping into unclear situations, working hands on with others and helping teams move forward even when the full plan is not yet defined.

We are looking for people with…

    Experience from leading change, business development, transformation or product/service delivery within HR, People, shared services or another complex environment.
    Strong understanding of HR processes, employee data, employee lifecycle capabilities and how digital tools can make work easier, more consistent and more effective for colleagues, managers and HR teams.
    The ability to turn business and people needs into clear priorities, practical plans and outcomes that others can understand and act on.
    Financial acumen with experience managing budgets, investments, and resource allocation.
    Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to balance value creation, cost optimization, and ROI.
    Experience working in changing environments where priorities shift, plans evolve and progress depends on close collaboration across different teams.
    Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, including the confidence and perseverance to work through different opinions, competing priorities and difficult conversations.
    Knowledge of governance, risk, compliance and operational excellence in relation to HR data, access, platforms, integrations or global people processes.
    Relevant HR understanding, with the ability to connect people related needs, processes and data to business outcomes.
    A degree within HR, business administration, organisational development, technology or a related field.

And people who are…

    Customer-focused and value-driven.
    Collaborative and hands on, with the ability to build strong partnerships while also getting close to the details when needed.
    Able to connect long term ambitions with day-to-day execution, even when the path forward is not fully clear.
    Resilient and persistent, with the energy to keep moving forward through complexity, changing direction and stakeholder challenges.
    Empowering leaders that develop people and create an inclusive environment.
    Curious, innovative, and open to new perspectives.
    Accountable, proactive, and focused on delivering outcomes.
    Clear communicators who can create alignment and engagement across diverse stakeholder groups, especially when priorities are unclear or opinions differ.

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.  

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

jobs.title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö, Pohjois-Suomi
jobs.description:
**Asiakkuuspäällikkö, Pohjois-Suomi**

Asiakkuuspäällikkönä myyt kattoturvallisuusratkaisuja ja kattotarkastuspalveluita asiakkaille, jotka omistavat tai hallinnoivat suuria kiinteistömääriä: kiinteistösijoittajille, isoille kiinteistönomistajille sekä kunnille, hyvinvointialueille ja muille julkisen sektorin toimijoille.

Tehtävässä ei myydä yksittäisiä urakoita kerrallaan. Roolissasi rakennat asiakkaan koko kiinteistökannalle kokonaiskuvan: mikä on kattojen turvallisuustilanne, mitä laki ja vastuu edellyttävät, missä järjestyksessä asiat kannattaa hoitaa ja millaisella tarkastus- ja kunnossapito-ohjelmalla kanta pysyy hallinnassa vuodesta toiseen. Kattotarkastus on usein ensimmäinen vaihe ja sen tuottama tieto muuttuu suunnitelmaksi, suunnitelma töiksi ja työt pitkiksi asiakassuhteiksi.

Työskentelet osana palveluliiketoiminnan myyntitiimiä ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä yksiköidemme myynti- ja asennusorganisaatioiden kanssa. Asiakkuus on sinun, mutta lopputulos syntyy yhteistyöllä. Kartoitus, tarkastus, suunnittelu, tarjouslaskenta ja asennus tulevat eri puolilta taloa, ja sinä pidät langat käsissäsi asiakkaan suuntaan.

**Odotamme sinulta**

- Usean vuoden kokemusta ratkaisumyynnistä yrityksille: mielellään rakennetun ympäristön, kiinteistöpalveluiden, teknisen kaupan tai rakennustuotteiden parissa.

- Näyttöjä pitkäjänteisestä asiakkuustyöstä: olet kasvattanut asiakassuhteita vuosien mittaan, et vain tehnyt yksittäisiä kauppoja.

- Varmuutta keskustella kaupallisista kysymyksistä sekä paikallisten että valtakunnallisten asiakkaiden päättäjien kanssa.

- Kokemuksen kautta hankittua johtamiskokemusta: olet vetänyt tiimiä, projektia, aluetta tai asiakkuutta ja saanut muut liikkeelle myös ilman muodollista esihenkilöasemaa.

- Aktiivista otetta uusasiakashankintaan ja kärsivällisyyttä pitkiin myyntisykleihin.

- Kokemusta ja osaamista kattoturvallisuusratkaisuista: tunnet tuotteet, asennustavat ja alaa ohjaavat vaatimukset niin, että asiakas luottaa arvioosi paikan päällä.

- Valmiutta matkustaa alueellasi ja säännöllisesti myös muualla Suomessa. Ajokortti ja valmius liikkua kohteissa katolla ja työmailla.

- Asuinpaikkaa Pohjois-Suomessa: Pohjois-Pohjanmaalla, Kainuussa tai Lapissa.


**Katsomme eduksi**

- Kokemusta julkisista hankinnoista ja puitejärjestelyistä

- Verkostoja Pohjois-Suomen kiinteistönomistajissa

- Kattotarkastus- tai kuntoarviotaustaa, työturvallisuuskortti- ja putoamissuojauksen pätevyyksiä

- Kokemusta huolto- tai palvelusopimusliiketoiminnan myynnistä


**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Selkeän oman vastuualueen ja vapauden rakentaa se omalla tavallasi sekä valtakunnallista näkyvyyttä nimettyjen asiakkuuksien kautta.

- Kasvavan palveluliiketoiminnan, jossa työsi näkyy suoraan tuloksessa ja jossa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten toimintaa kehitetään.

- Tuen takanasi: oma suunnittelu ja tarjouslaskenta, kattotarkastajat, asennusorganisaatio, Sadexin asennusmyyntiorganisaatio

- Kiinteän kuukausipalkan sekä työn edellyttämät välineet ja varusteet.

- Kokeneen, mutkattoman porukan, jossa asiat sovitaan suoraan ja päätökset syntyvät nopeasti.

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa koko liiketoiminta-alueen kehittämiseen


**Lisätiedot ja hakemukset**

- Palkka: kuukausipalkka

- Lisätiedot ja hakemukset: Joni Louhivaara joni.louhivaara@sadex.fi

- Haku päättyy: 14.9.2026
