jobs.title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the  opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native level Japanese, business level English




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s  Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.  https://dev.notion.so/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: MAX  søker skiftleder
jobs.description:
Max er Sveriges eldste og mest likte hamburgerkjede! Vi startet allerede i 1968 i Gällivare i Sverige. Det gjør familiebedriften vår til en av de hamburgerkjedene som har eksistert lengst i hele Europa. 12. mai 2011 åpnet Max sin første restaurant i Oslo i Norge. Ambisjonen er den samme som for 50 år siden – med de beste råvarene skal vi servere de beste hamburgerne.

Vi vil bli verdens beste burgerkjede, og vi vet at veien dit går gjennom engasjerte ledere, sterke team, god service og virkelig gode burgere. Nå søker vi deg som vil ta første steg i lederkarrieren din og være med på å skape serviceopplevelser i verdensklasse ved hvert besøk. 

Som skiftleder hos MAX er du en nøkkelperson i restaurantens daglige arbeid. Du leder teamet på stedet, sørger for at gjestene får best mulig opplevelse, og at restauranten alltid leverer på topp – både når det gjelder kvalitet, tempo og service. Du har oversikt over hele virksomheten: fra kjøkken og kasse til servering og uteområder. Sammen med kollegaene dine skaper du en arbeidsplass der arbeidsglede, fellesskap og utvikling står i sentrum. 

Vi søker deg som er serviceinnstilt, trives i høyt tempo og har en naturlig evne til å inspirere andre. Du er et forbilde som leder ved å være til stede, engasjert og løsningsorientert. Du liker å se kollegaene dine vokse og utvikle seg, og du forstår viktigheten av alltid å sette gjesten i fokus. 

 

Hovedarbeidsoppgaver 

  • Lede og coache teamet i det daglige arbeidet 
  • Sikre at gjestene får en serviceopplevelse i verdensklasse 
  • Planlegge, bemanne og lære opp innenfor restaurantens ulike områder 
  • Ha oversikt over kjøkken, kasse, restaurantområde og uteområde 
  • Bidra til at restauranten er ren, ryddig og innbydende 
  • Jobbe aktivt med våre verdier: Mot, Lidenskap og Fellesskap 

 

Hva tilbyr vi? 

  • En jobb med høyt tempo og gode utviklingsmuligheter 
  • Intern opplæring og mulighet til å søke vårt utdanningsprogram for fremtidige restaurantsjefer 
  • Varierende arbeidstider – dag, kveld, natt og helg 
  • Lønn og vilkår i henhold til tariffavtale samt ledertillegg 
  • En arbeidsplass der alle har like muligheter, rettigheter og plikter

jobs.title: AI Agent Security Architect
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI Agent Security Architect to function as the primary technical

authority for Replit’s autonomous and AI agent security blueprint. In this critical role, you

will design, implement, and maintain the runtime defense systems, guardrail

frameworks, and sandboxing architectures that govern AI agents executing code,

invoking tools, and reasoning across our platform. You will be a key technical

contributor—leading high-impact AI security initiatives and bridging the gap between

non-deterministic AI behavior and rigorous cybersecurity controls for both engineering

and executive leadership.



What You'll Do

 - AI Agent Security Strategy & Technical Execution

 - AI Agent Security Blueprint: Define the long-term vision and architectural patterns for securing autonomous agent workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, multi-turn reasoning loops, and multi-agent coordination.

 - Runtime Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Architect and deploy dynamic input/output guardrail systems, semantic firewalls, and real-time intent verification filters to prevent goal hijacking, system prompt leaks, and indirect prompt injections.

 - Agent Execution & Tool Sandboxing: Partner with Infrastructure and AppSec teams to design secure, short-lived, micro-isolated environments (e.g., microVMs, WebAssembly, container sandboxes) where agents can dynamically execute code, run shell commands, and interact with host operating systems safely.

 - Agentic Threat Modeling & Red Teaming: Conduct specialized threat modeling against non-deterministic systems. Lead automated and manual AI red-teaming initiatives to uncover vulnerabilities in RAG context pipelines, vector stores, and tool-calling interfaces.

 - Identity, Delegation & Least Privilege: Architect fine-grained permission models and step-up Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) authorization patterns for agents acting on behalf of users—ensuring agents never exceed the delegated privileges of the end user or misuse API keys.

 - Context & Memory Boundary Security: Design strict data isolation and poisoning prevention controls for vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and long-term conversation memories across multi-tenant workloads.

 - Risk Management & Cross-Functional Enablement

 - Maintain the AI Security Source of Truth: Define, document, and maintain authoritative secure design patterns and SDKs for engineering teams building internal or customer-facing AI agent capabilities.

 - Contribution to Risk Register: Identify, quantify, and document non-deterministic and agentic security risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, MITRE ATLAS), ensuring they are accurately represented in the Cybersecurity Risk Register.

 - Auditability & Observability: Design tamper-evident logging and telemetry standards for agent reasoning chains, tool execution history, and context assembly to support incident response, forensics, and GRC requirements.

 - Compliance & Sales Enablement: Partner with GRC to translate complex AI security controls into enterprise-ready audit documentation (e.g., ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act readiness) and support Sales on complex enterprise security inquiries regarding AI safety.

Required Skills & Experience

 - 6+ years of experience in security engineering or security architecture, with at least 2+ years dedicated specifically to AI/ML security, LLM application security, or securing agentic frameworks.

 - Deep understanding of agentic architectures and protocols (e.g., Model Context. Protocol (MCP), LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, ReAct frameworks, and vector database technologies).

 - Hands-on expertise with threat vectors unique to agentic AI: Indirect Prompt

 - Injection, Goal Hijacking, Tool Parameter Tampering, Data Poisoning, and Context Contamination.

 - Strong background in applying safety standards and risk frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE ATLAS.

 - Proficiency in Python, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript with a proven track record of reviewing code and building functional security tooling or guardrails.

 - Experience authoring, maintaining, and evangelizing technical security architecture documentation.

 - Exceptional ability to communicate complex non-deterministic AI risks to both deep technical engineers and executive stakeholders.

 - Proven track record of contributing to an enterprise Cybersecurity Risk Register.

Bonus Qualifications

 - Experience designing runtime sandboxing and isolation technologies (e.g., Firecracker, gVisor, Docker, WebAssembly) for dynamic code execution environments.





Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

Apulaisylilääkärinä vastuullasi on kouluterveydenhuolto Varhan perhekeskuksen palvelukokonaisuudessa, johon kuuluvat neuvolapalvelut, opiskeluhuollon palvelut, perheneuvolapalvelut, ennaltaehkäisevä perhetyö, lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu sekä alaikäisten perustason mielenterveys- ja päihdepalvelut. Vastaat oman sektorisi lääkärityön organisoinnista ja kehittämisestä sekä toimit kouluterveydenhuollon lääkäreiden lähiesihenkilönä.

Tehtävääsi kuuluu noin 50 % kliinistä perhekeskuslääkärin työtä ja 50 % hallinnollisia tehtäviä. Lisäksi teet verkostotyötä Lanupen sisäisten kumppaneiden sekä avoterveydenhuollon, sivistystoimen, erikoissairaanhoidon ja muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa. Osa tehtävistä on mahdollista hoitaa etätyönä.

Yhteistyö avoterveydenhuollon ylilääkäreiden kanssa on olennainen osa työtäsi, sillä avoterveydenhuollon lääkärit osallistuvat kouluterveydenhuollon lääkärien tehtäviin. Tukenasi toimii perhekeskuslääkäreiden yksikössä ylilääkäri sekä neljä apulaisylilääkäriä. Valittuna täydennät tiimiä viidentenä apulaisylilääkärinä.

Työpisteesi sijaitsee Mäntymäen talossa osoitteessa Kunnallissairaalantie 20, 20700 Turku.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen ja vaikuttavan tehtävän, jossa pääset kehittämään Varhan lasten, nuorten ja perheiden palveluita perhekeskuslääkäreiden yksikössä. Saat ympärillesi toimivan ja asiantuntevan yhteistyöverkoston sekä mahdollisuuden tehdä työtä, jolla on merkitystä niin yksilöille kuin koko palvelukokonaisuudelle.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Toivomme, että sinulla on kiinnostusta kehittää kouluterveydenhuollon palveluita ja toimia sekä kliinisessä että hallinnollisessa roolissa erilaisissa verkostoissa.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on Suomessa laillistetun lääkärin oikeudet. Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa sekä tyydyttävää ruotsin kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa.

Eduksi luemme yleislääketieteen tai muun soveltuvan erikoisalan erikoislääkärin oikeudet sekä kokemuksen esihenkilötehtävistä.

Hae tehtävään - odotamme sinua joukkoomme!

jobs.title: Architecte réseaux laser en espace libre (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job posting in English below

Rejoignez Airbus Defence & Space !

Au sein d'Airbus Defence and Space, le rôle de l'entité Connected Intelligence (CI) est de fournir à ses clients des solutions de communications sécurisées, à haut débit, multimédia (voix, données, vidéo), disponibles à tout moment et partout dans le monde.

Pour ce faire, CI est devenu un leader mondial des communications par satellites (SATCOM) civiles et militaires capable de concevoir et opérer des infrastructures en propre ou pour ses clients. Pour maintenir ce leadership, CI mène une politique ambitieuse d'innovation afin d'étoffer son portefeuille de solutions à haute valeur ajoutée.

Dans ce but, CI cherche un/une Architecte réseaux Laser en espace libre (H/F) maîtrisant les technologies de communication par Laser et la réalisation de réseaux incluant des segments Laser :
Réseau IP conventionnels;
Réseaux point à point, point à multipoint, maillés, ... ;
Porteurs fixes et mobiles;
Milieux : spatial, aérien, terrestre, maritime.


Vous avez un intérêt pour les réseaux IP et les systèmes de communication complexes, hautement sécurisés. Vous êtes capable de faire preuve de créativité et avez l'envie de vous investir sur des sujets techniques complexes et innovants. Vous serez intégré(e) à un pôle d'ingénierie chargé de concevoir et développer les systèmes de communication de défense du futur.  

Les activités actuelles de l'équipe ont pour but d'exploiter les possibilités offertes par les technologies émergentes (laser, quantique,...) dans le cadre des services de communications sécurisés, sur tout type de support (satellite, 5G,...), en utilisant des techniques de réseaux programmables (SDN).

Vous prendrez part en tant qu'Architecte aux différents projets faisant appel aux moyens de communication Laser.

Ce poste exige une connaissance des risques potentiels de non-conformité.

Le/la titulaire s'engage à agir avec intégrité, fondement du succès et de la croissance durable de la Société.

Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous aurez les missions suivantes :
Assurer une veille technologique permanente au contact des équipes internes et des équipementiers ;
Supporter les avant ventes à savoir (ex : pédagogie envers les équipes internes et envers les clients; proposition de solutions techniques) ;
Maquetter des solutions ou des preuves de concept ;
Contribuer à la conception des solutions destinées aux clients (ex: spécification des segments Laser; Interface avec les autres composants systèmes) ;
Spécifier les évolutions nécessaires des composant Airbus Defence & Space pour implémenter ces solutions et identifier d'éventuels nouveaux composants à développer ;
Assurer le maintien de tous les documents techniques liés aux solutions proposées ;
Support et expertise aux équipes de conception et d'IVQ système.


Profil :

Vous avez la formation, les expériences et compétences suivantes :
Titulaire d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur (ou équivalent) dans le domaine des réseaux informatiques avec une spécialisation sur les systèmes optiques Laser et Optoélectronique ;
Expérience dans des environnements réseaux complexes, typés opérateurs télécom ou militaire ou WAN étendus de grands groupes ou d'OIV ;
Capacité reconnue à concevoir et réaliser des solutions techniques livrées à des clients ;
Connaissance des problématiques de transmission par laser ainsi que des réseaux IP classiques ;
Notions d'ingénierie des systèmes complexes ;
Vous êtes autonome et désireux de porter des sujets innovants ;
Vous savez travailler en équipes pluridisciplinaires et avez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles ;
Niveau de négociation en Français et avancé en Anglais.


====

Join Airbus Defence & Space !

Within Airbus Defence and Space CIS, the role of the Connected Intelligence (CI) business unit is to provide its customers with secure, high-speed, multimedia (voice, data, video) communications solutions available at any time and anywhere in the world.

To achieve this, CI has become a world leader in civil and military satellite communications (SATCOM), capable of designing and operating infrastructure on its own or for its customers. To maintain this leadership, CI is pursuing an ambitious policy of innovation to expand its portfolio of high value-added solutions.

To this end, CI is looking for a Free Space Laser Network Architect (M/F) who is proficient in laser communication technologies and the implementation of networks including laser segments:
Conventional IP network;
Point to point, point to multipoint, mesh networks, ... ;
Fixed and mobile carriers;
Environments: space, air, land, sea.


You have an interest in IP networks and complex, highly secure communication systems.

Medžiagų ir kokybės kontrolė: Priimti, sandėliuoti ir tikrinti gaunamų medžiagų bei įrangos kokybę.
Dokumentacijos tvarkymas: Rengti projektų vykdymo dokumentus ir tiksliai vesti darbo laiko apskaitą.
Saugos užtikrinimas: Kontroliuoti, kad objektuose būtų griežtai laikomasi visų darbuotojų saugos, sveikatos ir priešgaisrinės apsaugos reikalavimų.

Gebėjimo spręsti nenumatytas situacijas objekte.
Aukštojo inžinerinio arba techninio išsilavinimo.

jobs.title: Legal Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Legal Operations Manager at Replit, you will be the central point of contact for legal requests across the company and the operational backbone of our contract lifecycle. You will triage and manage incoming legal requests, own contract management end to end, and support broader corporate compliance and data privacy work. Your meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach will keep legal operations running smoothly and reduce risk across the business.

Think of yourself as the air traffic controller of our legal universe — making sure every contract, request, and approval lands safely, on time, and in the right hands. Your meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach will not just keep Legal running smoothly — it will make the whole company move faster.

If you love building systems, closing loops, and being the person everyone turns to when they need to get something done right, this role was made for you.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL DO:



Legal Operations

 - Drive the Legal team's operational strategy, understand operational challenges, identify opportunities to improve systems and workflows

 - Implement, maintain, and optimize a best in class AI driven tech stack. Partner cross functionally with AI and GTM/marketing/partnerships teams to identify technologies, negotiate with vendors, and drive implementation.

 - Partner closely with Finance and Legal leadership to manage budget, forecasting, accruals, and track spend

 - Working closely with leadership, own planning cycles, OKRs, and data reporting and metrics

 - Manage outside counsel relationships, including new engagements, billing guidelines invoicing, and e-billing. Drive outside counsel management strategy with a focus on cost discipline and operational accountability

 - Build and maintain knowledge management platforms and learning and development programs that keep the team current and operating effectively.

 - Run the day-to-day operations of the Legal & team, driving efficiencies that enable the team to perform its best work (for example, manage vendors, contract signatures, attorney memberships, internal practice guidelines, expenses, team meetings).



Contract Lifecycle Management

 - Serve as the primary intake point for legal requests, triaging by urgency and complexity and routing to the right owner

 - Organize and consolidate incoming legal requests into a centralized tracking system

 - Handle baseline legal reviews and approvals directly, escalating complex or high-risk matters to legal counsel

 - Develop and maintain tooling and processes to track requests, contracts, and deadlines

 - Track responsible managers and renewal deadlines

 - Manage contract templates and organization (Vendor MSA, NDAs, offer letters)

 - Implement and maintain safeguards



Corporate and Compliance Matters

 - Assist in strategic corporate transactions, including due diligence and virtual data room building

 - Support post-closing integrations and follow-ups

 - Manage annual filings, updates, and deadline tracking

 - Prepare and update internal company policies

 - Prepare and update team trainings on legal issue spotting, privacy, governance, and HR

 - Track and implement updates to website and privacy policy terms

 - Organize and maintain general records

 - Prepare checklists and provide project support as needed



Data Privacy

 - Track data subject requests (deletions) and assist preparing transparency reporting

 - Organize and maintain data maps

 - Coordinate and track data protection impact assessments



Required Skills & Experience

 - Minimum of 5 years of proven legal administrative experience

 - Motivation to grow and expand knowledge base

 - Strong attention to detail and proofreading ability

 - Ability to prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously and work independently to complete tasks within given deadlines



Bonus Points

 - High growth startup experience

 - Experience building out lean legal teams to carry out corporate responsibilities

 



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

Position Title: Produce Clerk - Full Time

Position Type: Full time

Job Requisition ID: 49560

Banner: Food Basics

Employment Type: Permanent

This position is part of a unionized bargaining unit. The hourly wage for this position starts at $18.00 - $21.35 and is established in accordance with the collective agreement. Depending on a candidateâs relevant knowledge, skills, education, and prior experience, a higher hourly wage may be offered. Any hourly wage offered for this role, whether starting or higher, will fall within the wage scale established for this position in accordance with the collective agreement.

This is a posting for an existing permanent full-time position

Experience a rewarding role at Food Basics as a Produce Clerk! You'll be the go-to person for ensuring our produce section is always fresh, well-stocked, and beautifully presented. Share your enthusiasm for fresh fruits and vegetables with our customers and help them find exactly what they need.

Our produce team is crucial to Food Basics' success, and we're looking for energetic individuals who love working with fresh food and enjoy helping others. If you thrive in a lively environment and are passionate about quality produce, we want you on our team!

What Youâll Do

  • Unload shipments of produce and sort items in the backroom and cooler.
  • Stock shelves and displays with fresh produce, ensuring items are rotated (first-in, first-out method) to maintain freshness.
  • Create visually appealing displays and arrange items neatly.
  • Inspect produce for freshness and quality, removing any damaged or spoiled items.
  • Ensure that all produce meets the store's quality standards.
  • Monitor temperature and humidity levels in the produce section to maintain optimal storage conditions.
  • Assist customers with locating specific items and provide information about different produce or products in other departments.
  • Offer recommendations on how to select and store produce.
  • Answer customer inquiries and address concerns.
  • Keep the produce section clean and organized, including sweeping and mopping as needed.
  • Clean and sanitize work areas, equipment, and tools regularly.
  • Dispose of waste and compostable materials properly.
  • Monitor inventory levels and restock items as needed.
  • Perform regular inventory counts and report any discrepancies.
  • Notify management of low stock or out-of-stock items.
  • Ensure all produce is correctly labeled with prices and product information.
  • Update signage for promotions, sales, and seasonal items.
  • Verify that prices in the system match the displayed prices.
  • Reduce and price items as needed.
  • Adhere to food safety and sanitation guidelines.
  • Use equipment and tools safely and properly.
  • Report any safety concerns or incidents to management.
  • Assist with gathering shopping carts or baskets and putting them away when needed.
  • Assist with special promotions, events, or projects as assigned by management.
  • Collaborate with other departments as needed.
  • Additional duties assigned by Management.

Qualifications

  • Customer service driven.
  • Able to stock merchandise and create displays.
  • Good product knowledge and attention to detail.
  • Able to lift between 30 to 50 pounds.
  • Retail experience is considered an asset.
  • Able to stand for extend periods of time.
  • Must be available to work flexible shifts which may include nights, weekends and holidays.

The responsibilities and relationships assigned to this role may change as is necessary to achieve Metro's business objectives.

Senior Associate Investor Reporting
Luxembourg
Line of Service Tax
Industry/Sector FS X-Sector

Management Level Senior Associate

Job ID: 743767WD


Job Description & Summary

At PwC, our people in tax services focus on providing advice and guidance to clients on tax planning, compliance, and strategy. These individuals help businesses navigate complex tax regulations and optimise their tax positions.

In tax reporting strategy at PwC, you will assist clients in developing tax reporting strategies and maintaining compliance with tax regulations. In this field, you will analyse financial data, interpret tax laws, and provide guidance on tax reporting requirements, aiming to optimise tax positions and minimise risks for businesses.
Pwc Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Associate Investment Fund Reporting (m/f/d). What if it was you?
Who we are: We are the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg, providing audit, tax and advisory services to a wide variety of clients. To make it happen, we count on the expertise of over 3,100 people from more than 80 different countries, who strive every day to reach excellence and team up to solve important problems through innovative solutions. We value diverse and singular career paths, embrace everyone's unique self and encourage our People to fuel their potential in a work environment that is inclusive, stimulating, and motivating.

Be a part of our team where you will:

• Work in a team of tax and regulatory reporting experts responsible for the preparation and review of investor tax and regulatory reporting for investment funds (UCITS and Alternatives), supporting our international clients across various jurisdictions and ensuring tax and regulatory compliance with applicable local and global requirements.
• Include the analysis and treatment of investment fund accounting information, the performance of calculations of the tax figures as well as the preparation and review of the final investor tax reporting such as German tax reporting;
• Collaborate on the continuous improvement and digital transformation of our reporting processes by exploring automation, data analytics and emerging AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality and client service;
• Address and support client tax queries across international tax frameworks at the investor, fund, and investment levels.;
• Have the opportunity to work closely with other tax and accounting teams in Luxembourg and with our Asset Management network worldwide;
• Have the opportunity to work on regulatory reporting for investment funds such as Solvency II reporting, AIFMD reporting, VAG reporting, SFDR reporting, CRR reporting…
• Be managing, supporting, developing a team of junior collaborators.

Let's talk about you. If you have …

• A university degree in economics, management or law, with a major in tax legislation and taxation;
• At least 3 years of experience within the international tax department of a commercial company, an audit/tax firm with focus on the fund industry as an asset;
• You are flexible and autonomous;
• You are interested in the Asset Management industry and you want to work with important Asset Managers;
• Your analytical and critical skills, your intellectual rigor and your writing skills will be key to help you succeed in this position;
• You are familiar with Microsoft Office package, data automation, Agentic AI is a plus;
• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of German or French would be considered as an asset.
• …You are the candidate we are looking for!

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. Head of MI & Reporting
Finance - Group - UI0801 - Senningerberg, Luxembourg (Hybrid)

About Waystone  

Waystone is a leading asset-servicing solutions provider of institutional governance, administration, risk and compliance services to financial institutions. With over 25 years' experience and a comprehensive range of specialist services to its name, Waystone helps our clients structure, operate and grow through our expertise, innovation and digitisation, backed by the operational scale to support global expansion.

Summary:

The Head of MI & Reporting is the engine room of Group FP&A's management information function. The role owns the monthly MI cycle end-to-end  from data aggregation and system integrity through to investor-grade reporting and executive presentations- and leads two direct reports in delivering that cycle with rigour and consistency. Critically, this role is the integrating layer between the FP&A business partners and the broader finance function. Success depends on aligning inputs across the team, driving standardisation in how we aggregate and analyse large data sets, and ensuring that reporting outputs are consistently high-quality, actionable and suited to an executive audience.
          
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

MI & Investor Reporting

• Own the monthly Group MI pack end-to-end: production, commentary, quality control and delivery to FP&A leadership, Waystone Executive team and investors, on time and to a consistently high standard.
• Lead all standard investor reporting on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis; manage ad-hoc queries from investors promptly and accurately.
• Own the Group reporting calendar, ensuring all key reporting requirements are known, tracked and executed by the FP&A team.
• Produce flash revenue reporting across legal entities, countries and product structures, with KPI and trend analysis that gives management a clear and timely read on performance.

FP&A Systems, Data & analytics

• Own the FP&A systems and toolset, ensuring data is well-controlled, models are scalable, and that new data sources are integrated in a structured and controlled way.
• Ensuring that the structuring of our data leads to improvements in our data quality/governance, and also surfaces relevant data in a more impactful way
• Comfortable with driving finance systems & finance process efficiency. You will identify and drive positive change to system structures and related processes which will support FP&A in raising our level.
• Experienced in driving automation in financial processes, and curious about the deployment of AI tooling to support efficiencies or deeper insights.
• Drive standardisation across the team in how we aggregate and analyse large data sets, reducing reliance on fragmented individual processes and moving to consistent, repeatable approaches.
• Coordinate the wider FP&A team to engage with Financial Control with the goal of addressing potential General Ledger integrity issues or identifying improvements to ERP data entry to enhance reporting.
• Work with relevant departments to gather client revenue and cost of sales data for analytical purposes, building reliable data flows that FP&A can depend on.

Revenue Analysis & Forward-Looking Insight

• Deliver monthly analysis on Opportunities, Wins and Onboarding to provide forward-looking insight into revenue trends and the pipeline impact on future performance.
• Connect revenue run-rate and ARR outputs (built by the wider FP&A team) into the MI reporting suite so that executives have a consistent view of both current and forward performance.
• Identify performance trends, anomalies and risks in the data and surface these with clear, well-evidenced commentary in the MI materials.

Budgeting & Forecasting

• Partner across FP&A and broader Finance function to co-ordinate the annual budget process for revenue and cost of sales, ensuring alignment of inputs and consistent methodology.
• Co-ordinate the quarterly revenue and cost of sales forecasting process with the country business partners.
• Prepare high-quality presentation materials to support budgeting and forecasting conversations with senior stakeholders.

Business Partnering & Coordination

• Act as the integrating layer between FP&A business partners and the MI function - aligning inputs, resolving data conflicts, ensuring all FP&A output is consistent across the various reporting layers and ensuring that what goes into the monthly pack reflects a single, agreed version of the truth.
• Collaborate with Country and Product leadership to provide financial guidance and ensure MI outputs are relevant, actionable and understood by the business.
• Build and maintain strong working relationships with all key internal and external stakeholders, including investors and senior leadership.

Team Leadership

• Lead and develop a team of two, setting clear priorities, defining reporting outputs and creating an environment where the team can do their best work.
• Continuously evolve how the team measures and presents performance, always seeking to increase the actionable impact of the analysis.
• Raise the bar on presentation quality across the team, ensuring all outputs - whether for internal leadership or external investors — are executive-ready.

REQUIREMENTS

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Experience:

• 10+ years post-qualified finance experience, with a meaningful proportion in FP&A or financial reporting in a complex, multi-entity environment.
• Proven track record of producing high-quality MI and management reporting for a senior or executive audience.
• Experience owning or managing financial planning and reporting systems, with a strong understanding of data flows and model architecture.
• Demonstrable ability to work with large, complex data sets- extracting insight, identifying anomalies and communicating findings clearly.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex financial analysis into clear, commercially relevant messaging for non-finance audiences.
• Experience managing and developing direct reports.
• Advanced Excel and Microsoft Office proficiency.

Desirable

• Experience with Power BI, Power Automate or similar BI and automation tooling; a track record of improving reporting efficiency through technology.
• Familiarity with Sage Intacct, Adaptive Planning or Salesforce.
• Experience in financial services, asset management or a similarly data-intensive, multi-jurisdiction business.

Education:

jobs.description:
Tax Service Officer (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

Joining a dynamic, international & multicultural team of dedicated and experienced people, you will be responsible for strengthening the Tax Services Regulatory Monitoring team.

Your role will consist in providing guidance regarding all tax impacts on Clearstream's services, to assist internal stakeholders Tax Services Regulatory Monitoring team is interacting with, as well as Clearstream customers on all tax matters related to Income and/or Corporate Actions payments.

You will act as a strategic internal consultant related to Clearstream business and applicable tax regimes and for the identification of any tax regulatory compliance issues/impacts pertaining to Clearstream acting as a fiscal agent.
In addition, following international market practices and working in collaboration with withholding tax agents, various tax authorities and operational teams, your role is to contribute in identifying any tax issues, prepare written communications, help clients and provide general guidance to the Head of Tax, Responsible Officer and upper Management bodies.

Your responsibilities:

• Become familiar with tax practice services, processes, roles and responsibilities
• Be a key member of the Asset Services Governance department working closely together with processing teams and the tax helpdesk teams cross locations
• Be in contact with relevant local tax authorities, custodians and tax advisors to ensure that (i) Clearstream's tax roles and responsibilities are clearly defined and complied with, and that (ii) Clearstream's clients have reliable support and the most updated tax market information
• Conduct relevant tax supervision to support compliance of Clearstream with its operational tax requirements - contractual agreements with local tax authorities
• Collaborate closely with other teams within the Clearstream organisation such as Product Management, Legal, Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit to ensure tax processes meet the standards of the market
• Review contracts (Statement of Work, Letter of Engagement) and other documents related to Tax Operations
• Anticipate and identify potential tax issues/impacts in relation to Tax services and counselling Head of Tax/Upper Management bodies in order to develop strategies-solutions to achieve effective de-risking
• Build internal and external relationships with relevant suppliers, customers tax authorities and local tax advisors/consultants.
• Provides quality customer care with a focus on potential tax issues/impacts in the offered Tax services
• Provide appropriate reasoning to guarantee rapid and efficient identification of any potential tax regulatory compliance issues/impacts and their related resolution as regards to complex tax related matters
• Execute work assignment in due time
• Report to upper Management any identified potential tax issues/impacts in relation to the Tax services and provide relevant recommendations in relation thereto
• Support a positive mindset and team attitude rather than individualism

Your profile:

• University degree in Finance/Law/Economics/Business/Tax or similar discipline
• Tax background with minimum 5 years of qualified professional experience in the field of international Withholding Tax on financial instruments as well as transaction tax.
• Tax knowledge and expertise on the European markets.
• Knowledge on collateral and securities lending business area is an asset
• Experience in banking/custody activities in an international environment
• Demonstrate learning ability and a strong analytical mindset
• Confident in ability to deliver the expected level of expertise to the Clearstream organisation
• Customer focused, risk culture, pro-active and able to work under pressure with good organisation and prioritisation skills
• Open minded in work approach and display a positive and enthusiastic attitude
• Strong team player in a multicultural environment, able to take initiative, highly motivated and flexible
• Excellent communication and analytical skills
• Fluent in English (Verbal and Written).

jobs.title: UNUTARNJI REVIZOR / UNUTARNJA REVIZORICA
jobs.description:
Gradonačelnik Grada Umaga – Umago, pročelnica Upravnog odjela za financije i proračun i pročelnica Upravnog odjela za imovinskopravne poslove na temelju članka 19. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi („Narodne novine“, broj 86/08., 61/11., 4/18., 112/19. i 17/25. – u nastavku teksta: ZSN), raspisuju JAVNI NATJEČAJ za prijam u službu na sljedeća radna mjesta:
  1. unutarnji revizor (1 izvršitelj - m/ž), na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od tri mjeseca.
Posebni uvjeti za prijam u službu:
  • sveučilišni diplomski studij ili sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij ekonomske ili pravne struke,
  • stručno ovlaštenje ministra financija za obavljanje poslova unutarnje revizije u javnom sektoru,
  • najmanje pet godina radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, od čega najmanje tri godine na poslovima unutarnje revizije ili revizije,
  • položen državni ispit za II. razinu.
Posebni uvjet za prijam u službu za gore navedena radna mjesta je i poznavanje rada na računalu. Kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijam u službu, propisane u članku 12. ZSN-a (punoljetnost, hrvatsko državljanstvo i zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prima). Za prijam u službu osobe koja je strani državljanin ili osobe bez državljanstva, pored ispunjavanja uvjeta propisanih posebnim zakonom, potrebno je prethodno odobrenje tijela državne uprave nadležnog za službeničke odnose. Za dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku potrebno je dostaviti ovjereni prijevod. Radnim iskustvom na odgovarajućim poslovima razumijeva se radno iskustvo (služba u upravnim tijelima jedinica lokalne ili područne /regionalne/ samouprave, državna služba, javna služba, radni odnos kod privatnog poslodavca, samostalno obavljanje profesionalne djelatnosti u skladu s posebnim propisima ili obavljanje poslova u međunarodnim organizacijama) ostvareno na poslovima odgovarajuće razine obrazovanja i struke, sukladno članku 13. ZSN-a. Natjecati se mogu i kandidati koji nemaju položen državni ispit propisane razine, uz obvezu da ga, ako zadovolje na probnom radu, polože u roku godine dana od dana početka rada u službi utvrđenog rješenjem o rasporedu na radno mjesto. Kandidati koji nemaju certifikat, uvjerenje, svjedodžbu ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu o poznavanju rada na računalu, a ispunjavaju ostale natječajne uvjete, mogu biti primljeni u službu i raspoređeni na radno mjesto pod uvjetom da u roku određenom Pravilnikom o unutarnjem redu gradske uprave („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 9/23., 13/23., 22/23., 5/24., 7/24., 11/24., 16/24., 17/24., 1/25., 7/25. i 7/26. – u nastavku teksta: Pravilnik) steknu odgovarajući certifikat, uvjerenje, svjedodžbu ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu. U službu ne može biti primljena osoba za čiji prijam postoje zapreke iz članka 15. i 16. ZSN-a. Kandidat koji ima pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti odgovarajuće isprave kao dokaz o statusu te druge dokaze sukladno posebnom zakonu kojim je uređeno to pravo, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, broj 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“, broj 84/21. i 13/26), člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, broj 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“, broj 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) i člankom 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina („Narodne novine“, broj 155/02., 47/10., 80/10. i 93/11.) dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Prilikom pozivanja na pravo prednosti kod prijma u službu prema posebnom zakonu, kada pravo prednosti ovisi o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod posljednjeg poslodavca (primjerice: da radni odnos nije prestao krivnjom radnika ili sporazumnim raskidom), potrebno je dostaviti preslik dokaza o načinu prestanka prethodnog radnog odnosa. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji i člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf odnosno https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje o priznatom statusu odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo navedeno pravo. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, nije dužan dokazivati svoj status pripadnika nacionalne manjine. Prijavi na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:
  • životopis
  • dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (presliku važeće osobne iskaznice, važeće putovnice, domovnice ili vojne iskaznice),
  • presliku diplome kojom se potvrđuje ispunjavanje uvjeta razine obrazovanja (stručne spreme) i struke određene ovim natječajem
  • elektronički zapis (u slučaju da je osiguranik podnio zahtjev u elektroničkom obliku preko korisničkih stranica Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), odnosno potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje koju Zavod na osobno traženje osiguranika izdaje na šalterima područnih službi/ureda Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne starije od trideset dana, računajući od dana objave natječaja u Narodnim novinama),
  • običnu presliku dokaza o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima za cijeli period koji je kao uvjet naveden u javnom natječaju (rješenje o rasporedu, ugovor o radu ili uvjerenje poslodavca o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima koje mora sadržavati: vrstu poslova koju je obavljao, koja struka i stupanj stručne spreme je zahtijevan za njih i vremensko razdoblje u kojem je kandidat obavljao navedene poslove), za radna mjesta pod rednim brojem 1, 2 i 3,
  • ako je u elektroničkom zapisu ili potvrdi o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (stvarna/potrebna stručna sprema / vrsta i razina obrazovanja) evidentiran radni staž, potrebno je priložiti dokaz da je osoba bez radnog iskustva ili s radnim iskustvom kraćim od 12 mjeseci na odgovarajućim poslovima u traženom zvanju i struci, koji mora sadržavati podatke o vrsti poslova koje je osoba obavljala, s kojim zvanjem i strukom te u kojem razdoblju (rješenje, ugovor o radu, potvrda poslodavca ili druga isprava kojom to dokazuje), za radno mjesto pod rednim brojem 4,
  • presliku dokaza o položenom državnom ispitu propisane razine (ako kandidat ima položen državni ispit propisane razine),
  • presliku stručnog ovlaštenja ministra financija za obavljanje poslova unutarnje revizije u javnom sektoru (za radno mjesto unutarnji revizor),
  • presliku dokaza o poznavanju rada na računalu (certifikat o poznavanju rada na računalu koji se priznaje u zemljama Europske unije ili uvjerenje o osposobljenosti za Računalnog operatera poslovne primjene računala ili svjedodžbu odgovarajućeg razreda srednje škole ili iskaz ocjena sveučilišnog ili stručnog studija (visokoškolske ustanove) iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno položen predmet informatike ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu ovlaštenog organizatora tečaja informatike iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno završen tečaj informatike u čijem su nastavnom sadržaju obuhvaćene osnove rada na računalu i operacijski sustav Windows, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook-elektronička pošta i rad na internetu,
  • vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu kandidata da kod njega ne postoje zapreke za prijam u službu iz članka 15. i članka 16. ZSN-a (izjavu nije potrebno ovjeravati).
Ako kandidat uz prijavu priloži isprave u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (vjenčani list, rodni list i sl.). U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona, odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti mail-adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prijavljuje. Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Kandidati koji se istovremeno prijavljuju na više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako pojedino radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu sa svim traženim prilozima. Dopunu prijavi moguće je podnijeti zaključno do dana isteka natječajnog roka. Za ocjenu ispunjavaju li podnositelji prijave uvjete naznačene u natječaju, mjerodavan je posljednji dan roka za podnošenje prijava na natječaj (osim za prijam vježbenika, obzirom da kandidati ne smiju imati 12 ili više mjeseci radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, stoga taj uvjet ispunjava podnositelj prijave koji potrebno radno iskustvo nije imao barem prvog dana roka za podnošenje prijava na javni natječaj za prijam u službu vježbenika). Prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu izabrani kandidat pozvat će se da u primjerenom roku dostavi uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv njega ne vodi kazneni postupak i uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se prima te dostavi na uvid izvornike dokaza o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, čije su preslike priložene uz prijavu na javni natječaj. Nedostavljanje traženih isprava smatrat će se odustankom od prijma u službu. Troškove izdavanja uvjerenja o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti snosi Grad (osim u slučaju odustanka kandidata od prijma u službu). Nakon izbora kandidata, a prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu, provjerit će po službenoj dužnosti postoji li zapreka za prijam u službu zbog pravomoćne osuđivanosti izabranog kandidata za kazneno djelo iz članka 15. ZSN-a te zapreke iz članka 16. ZSNa. Uredna prijava je ona prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju, u obliku navedenom u natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i njena prijava neće biti razmatrana, te će joj o tome biti dostavljena pisana obavijest. Osoba nema pravo podnošenja pravnog lijeka protiv te obavijesti. Osoba koja je podnijela nepotpunu prijavu, neće biti pozvana na dopunu prijave. Za kandidate prijavljene na javni natječaj, koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, bit će provedena prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj. Prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja podnose se u zatvorenim omotnicama na adresu: Grad Umag – Umago, Povjerenstvo za provedbu natječaja, Trg slobode 7, 52470 Umag, u roku od 15 dana od dana objave natječaja u „Narodnim novinama“, s obveznom naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ ZA PRIJAM (upisati naziv radnog mjesta na koji se kandidat prijavljuje) – NE OTVARAJ“. Prijave se mogu neposredno predati i u pisarnicu Grada Umaga – Umago, Trg slobode 7 (prizemlje). Rješenje o prijmu u službu izabranog kandidata dostavlja se javnom objavom na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga – Umago (www.umag.hr) najkasnije 60 dana od isteka roka za podnošenje prijava na javni natječaj, a dostava se smatra obavljenom istekom osmoga dana od dana javne objave navedenog rješenja. Opis poslova i podaci o plaći radnog mjesta koje se popunjava ovim natječajem, način obavljanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata, područje provjere te pravni i drugi izvori za pripremanje kandidata za provjeru navedeni su na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga –Umago www.umag.hr (lokacija „Zapošljavanje“). Na oglasnoj ploči Grada Umaga – Umago i na mrežnoj stranici www.umag.hr (lokacija „Zapošljavanje“) objavit će se vrijeme održavanja prethodne provjere, najmanje pet dana prije održavanja provjere. III. PROVJERA ZNANJA I SPOSOBNOSTI KANDIDATA Za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj, koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete, provest će se prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti, sukladno članku 22. ZSN-a. Prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti kandidata obavlja se putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Smatra se da je kandidat, koji nije pristupio prethodnoj provjeri znanja, povukao prijavu na javni natječaj. Pravila provjere znanja i sposobnosti Po dolasku na provjeru znanja, od kandidata će biti zatraženo predočenje odgovarajuće identifikacijske isprave radi utvrđivanja identiteta. Po utvrđivanju identiteta i svojstva kandidata, kandidatima će biti podijeljena pitanja. Za svaki dio provjere znanja kandidatima se dodjeljuju bodovi od 1 do 10. Intervju se provodi samo s kandidatima koji su ostvarili najmanje 50% bodova na pisanom testiranju. Smatra se da je kandidat zadovoljio ako je na intervjuu ostvario najmanje 5 bodova. Za vrijeme provjere znanja i sposobnosti nije dopušteno: - koristiti se bilo kakvom literaturom odnosno bilješkama, - koristiti mobitel ili druga komunikacijska sredstva, - napuštati prostoriju u kojoj se provjera odvija, - razgovarati s ostalim kandidatima niti na bilo koji način remetiti koncentraciju kandidata. Ukoliko pojedini kandidat prekrši naprijed navedena pravila bit će udaljen s provjere znanja, a njegov rezultat Povjerenstvo neće priznati niti ocjenjivati. Ai sensi dell'art. 19 della Legge sugli impiegati e sul personale tecnico nelle unità di autogoverno locale e territoriale (regionale) (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 86/08, 61/11, 4/18, 112/19 e 17/25 – di seguito: LIPT), il Sindaco della Città di Umag – Umago, l’assessora alle finanze e al bilancio e l’assessora agli affari giuridico-patrimoniali indicono il seguente BANDO DI CONCORSO PUBBLICO per l’assunzione dei seguenti profili professionali:
  1. revisore interno (n. 1 posto, ambosessi), a tempo indeterminato, con periodo di prova obbligatorio di tre mesi.
Requisiti richiesti:
  • laurea magistrale, laurea a ciclo unico o diploma specialistico di secondo livello in economia o giurisprudenza,
  • abilitazione professionale del ministro delle finanze per lo svolgimento delle attività di revisione interna nel settore pubblico,
  • almeno cinque anni di esperienza lavorativa in mansioni corrispondenti, di cui almeno tre in ruoli di revisione o revisione interna,
  • superamento dell’esame di Stato di II livello.
Per tutti i suddetti posti di lavoro costituisce requisito specifico per l’assunzione in servizio il possesso delle competenze informatiche. I candidati devono altresì soddisfare i criteri generali per l'assunzione in servizio previsti dall'art. 12 della LIPT (maggiore età, cittadinanza croata e idoneità sanitaria per svolgere le mansioni del posto di lavoro per il quale il candidato viene assunto). I cittadini stranieri o apolidi possono essere assunti in servizio previa autorizzazione dell’autorità statale competente per i rapporti di pubblico impiego e previo adempimento delle formalità previste da leggi specifiche. La documentazione redatta in lingua straniera deve essere prodotta in traduzione giurata. Ai fini del presente Bando, per esperienza lavorativa in mansioni appropriate si intende l’esperienza maturata nell’ambito di attività lavorative — ivi comprese quelle svolte presso enti amministrativi delle unità di autogoverno locale o territoriale /regionale/, servizio pubblico, servizio statale, presso datori di lavoro privati, nell’ambito dell’esercizio autonomo di attività professionali conformemente a disposizioni normative speciali, ovvero presso organizzazioni internazionali – purché riferite a mansioni coerenti con il livello di istruzione richiesto e con il profilo professionale oggetto della selezione, ai sensi dell’articolo 13 della LIPT. Possono presentare candidatura anche i candidati che non abbiano ancora superato l’esame di Stato del livello prescritto, a condizione che lo sostengano con esito positivo entro un anno dalla data di inizio del servizio, come previsto dalla decisione relativa all’assegnazione del posto, e subordinatamente al superamento del periodo di prova. I candidati che non sono in possesso di certificati, attestati, pagelle o altri documenti comprovanti le competenze informatiche di base, ma che risultano essere in possesso degli altri requisiti richiesti, possono essere assunti a condizione che la relativa pagella, attestato, certificato o altro documento probatorio venga conseguito entro la scadenza prevista dal Regolamento sull’ordinamento interno dell’amministrazione civica (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, nn. 9/23, 13/23, 22/23, 5/24, 7/24, 11/24, 16/24, 17/24, 1/25, 7/25 e 7/26 – di seguito: Regolamento). Non possono essere assunti candidati per i quali sussistono gli impedimenti previsti dagli artt. 15 e 16 della LIPT. I candidati che si avvalgono del diritto di precedenza sono tenuti a indicarlo presentando l'apposita documentazione probatoria e altri documenti previsti dalla rispettiva legge specifica, con diritto di precedenza rispetto agli altri candidati a parità di condizioni. I candidati che si avvalgono del diritto di precedenza di assunzione in ottemperanza all'art. 101 della Legge sui difensori croati della Guerra patria e sui membri delle rispettive famiglie (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 e 156/23), all’art. 47 della Legge sulle vittime civili della Guerra patria (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 84/21 e 13/26), all'art. 48f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi militari e civili di guerra (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 e 98/19), all'art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e assunzione in servizio delle persone con disabilità (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 e 32/20) e all’art. 22 della Legge costituzionale sui diritti delle minoranze nazionali (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 155/02, 47/10, 80/10 e 93/11) sono tenuti a specificare tale diritto nella domanda di assunzione, con diritto di precedenza rispetto agli altri candidati che concorrono alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che desiderano fare appello al diritto di precedenza previsto dalla legge specifica devono presentare la copia fotostatica del documento comprovante le modalità di cessazione del precedente rapporto di lavoro (es.: cessazione dovuta non per colpa del dipendente o tramite risoluzione consensuale) nei casi in cui la prelazione dipenda dal tipo di cessazione del precedente rapporto di lavoro. Oltre alla documentazione prevista dal presente Bando, i candidati che fanno appello al diritto di precedenza di assunzione in osservanza all'art. 101 della Legge sui difensori croati della Guerra patria e sui membri delle rispettive famiglie, altresì all’art. 47 della Legge sulle vittime civili della Guerra patria sono tenuti a corredare la domanda di assunzione con la documentazione probatoria disciplinata dal Ministero dei difensori croati e indicata sul sito all'indirizzo: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf ovvero https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Oltre alla documentazione probatoria attestante il possesso dei requisiti richiesti, i candidati che intendono fare appello al diritto di precedenza di assunzione ai sensi dell'articolo 48f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi militari e civili di guerra devono allegare l’apposito provvedimento o certificato comprovante il riconoscimento della condizione a cui fa appello. I candidati che intendono fare appello al diritto di precedenza di assunzione contemplato dall'art. 22 della Legge costituzionale sui diritti delle minoranze nazionali non sono tenuti a comprovare la propria appartenenza alla minoranza nazionale.
