jobs.title: VIŠI STRUČNI SURADNIK/VIŠA STRUČNA SURADNICA ZA IMOVINSKOPRAVNE POSLOVE (VJEŽBENIK/ICA)
jobs.description:
Gradonačelnik Grada Umaga – Umago, pročelnica Upravnog odjela za financije i proračun i pročelnica Upravnog odjela za imovinskopravne poslove na temelju članka 19. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi („Narodne novine“, broj 86/08., 61/11., 4/18., 112/19. i 17/25. – u nastavku teksta: ZSN), raspisuju

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za prijam u službu na sljedeća radna mjesta:

Upravni odjel za imovinskopravne poslove

  1. viši stručni suradnik za imovinskopravne poslove (1 izvršitelj – m/ž), na određeno vrijeme od 12 mjeseci (vježbenik za obavljanje vježbeničke prakse).

Posebni uvjeti za prijam u službu:

  • sveučilišni diplomski studij ili sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij pravne struke,
  • bez radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima ili s radnim iskustvom kraćim od vremena propisanog za vježbenički staž.

Posebni uvjet za prijam u službu za gore navedena radna mjesta je i poznavanje rada na računalu.

Kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijam u službu, propisane u članku 12. ZSN-a (punoljetnost, hrvatsko državljanstvo i zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prima).

Za prijam u službu osobe koja je strani državljanin ili osobe bez državljanstva, pored ispunjavanja uvjeta propisanih posebnim zakonom, potrebno je prethodno odobrenje tijela državne uprave nadležnog za službeničke odnose.

Za dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku potrebno je dostaviti ovjereni prijevod.

Radnim iskustvom na odgovarajućim poslovima razumijeva se radno iskustvo (služba u upravnim tijelima jedinica lokalne ili područne /regionalne/ samouprave, državna služba, javna služba, radni odnos kod privatnog poslodavca, samostalno obavljanje profesionalne djelatnosti u skladu s posebnim propisima ili obavljanje poslova u međunarodnim organizacijama) ostvareno na poslovima odgovarajuće razine obrazovanja i struke, sukladno članku 13. ZSN-a.

Natjecati se mogu i kandidati koji nemaju položen državni ispit propisane razine, uz obvezu da ga, ako zadovolje na probnom radu, polože u roku godine dana od dana početka rada u službi utvrđenog rješenjem o rasporedu na radno mjesto.

Kandidati koji nemaju certifikat, uvjerenje, svjedodžbu ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu o poznavanju rada na računalu, a ispunjavaju ostale natječajne uvjete, mogu biti primljeni u službu i raspoređeni na radno mjesto pod uvjetom da u roku određenom Pravilnikom o unutarnjem redu gradske uprave („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 9/23., 13/23., 22/23., 5/24., 7/24., 11/24., 16/24., 17/24., 1/25., 7/25. i 7/26. – u nastavku teksta: Pravilnik) steknu odgovarajući certifikat, uvjerenje, svjedodžbu ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu.

U službu ne može biti primljena osoba za čiji prijam postoje zapreke iz članka 15. i 16. ZSN-a.

Kandidat koji ima pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti odgovarajuće isprave kao dokaz o statusu te druge dokaze sukladno posebnom zakonu kojim je uređeno to pravo, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, broj 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“, broj 84/21. i 13/26), člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, broj 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“, broj 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) i člankom 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina („Narodne novine“, broj 155/02., 47/10., 80/10. i 93/11.) dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Prilikom pozivanja na pravo prednosti kod prijma u službu prema posebnom zakonu, kada pravo prednosti ovisi o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod posljednjeg poslodavca (primjerice: da radni odnos nije prestao krivnjom radnika ili sporazumnim raskidom), potrebno je dostaviti preslik dokaza o načinu prestanka prethodnog radnog odnosa.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji i člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

odnosno

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje o priznatom statusu odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo navedeno pravo.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, nije dužan dokazivati svoj status pripadnika nacionalne manjine.

Prijavi na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:

  • životopis,
  • dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (presliku važeće osobne iskaznice, važeće putovnice, domovnice ili vojne iskaznice),
  • presliku diplome kojom se potvrđuje ispunjavanje uvjeta razine obrazovanja (stručne spreme) i struke određene ovim natječajem (osoba koja je obrazovanje završila u inozemstvu dužna je dostaviti i dokaz o priznavanju/vrednovanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije u Republici Hrvatskoj),
  • elektronički zapis (u slučaju da je osiguranik podnio zahtjev u elektroničkom obliku preko korisničkih stranica Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), odnosno potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje koju Zavod na osobno traženje osiguranika izdaje na šalterima područnih službi/ureda Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne starije od trideset dana, računajući od dana objave natječaja u Narodnim novinama),
  • običnu presliku dokaza o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima za cijeli period koji je kao uvjet naveden u javnom natječaju (rješenje o rasporedu, ugovor o radu ili uvjerenje poslodavca o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima koje mora sadržavati: vrstu poslova koju je obavljao, koja struka i stupanj stručne spreme je zahtijevan za njih i vremensko razdoblje u kojem je kandidat obavljao navedene poslove), za radna mjesta pod rednim brojem 1, 2 i 3,
  • ako je u elektroničkom zapisu ili potvrdi o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (stvarna/potrebna stručna sprema / vrsta i razina obrazovanja) evidentiran radni staž, potrebno je priložiti dokaz da je osoba bez radnog iskustva ili s radnim iskustvom kraćim od 12 mjeseci na odgovarajućim poslovima u traženom zvanju i struci, koji mora sadržavati podatke o vrsti poslova koje je osoba obavljala, s kojim zvanjem i strukom te u kojem razdoblju (rješenje, ugovor o radu, potvrda poslodavca ili druga isprava kojom to dokazuje), za radno mjesto pod rednim brojem 4,
  • presliku dokaza o položenom državnom ispitu propisane razine (ako kandidat ima položen državni ispit propisane razine),
  • presliku stručnog ovlaštenja ministra financija za obavljanje poslova unutarnje revizije u javnom sektoru (za radno mjesto unutarnji revizor),
  • presliku dokaza o poznavanju rada na računalu (certifikat o poznavanju rada na računalu koji se priznaje u zemljama Europske unije ili uvjerenje o osposobljenosti za Računalnog operatera poslovne primjene računala ili svjedodžbu odgovarajućeg razreda srednje škole ili iskaz ocjena sveučilišnog ili stručnog studija (visokoškolske ustanove) iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno položen predmet informatike ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu ovlaštenog organizatora tečaja informatike iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno završen tečaj informatike u čijem su nastavnom sadržaju obuhvaćene osnove rada na računalu i operacijski sustav Windows, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook-elektronička pošta i rad na internetu,
  • vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu kandidata da kod njega ne postoje zapreke za prijam u službu iz članka 15. i članka 16. ZSN-a (izjavu nije potrebno ovjeravati).

Ako kandidat uz prijavu priloži isprave u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (vjenčani list, rodni list i sl.).

U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona, odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti mail-adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prijavljuje. Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati.

Kandidati koji se istovremeno prijavljuju na više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako pojedino radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu sa svim traženim prilozima.

Dopunu prijavi moguće je podnijeti zaključno do dana isteka natječajnog roka.

Za ocjenu ispunjavaju li podnositelji prijave uvjete naznačene u natječaju, mjerodavan je posljednji dan roka za podnošenje prijava na natječaj (osim za prijam vježbenika, obzirom da kandidati ne smiju imati 12 ili više mjeseci radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, stoga taj uvjet ispunjava podnositelj prijave koji potrebno radno iskustvo nije imao barem prvog dana roka za podnošenje prijava na javni natječaj za prijam u službu vježbenika).

Prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu izabrani kandidat pozvat će se da u primjerenom roku dostavi uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv njega ne vodi kazneni postupak i uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se prima te dostavi na uvid izvornike dokaza o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, čije su preslike priložene uz prijavu na javni natječaj.

Nedostavljanje traženih isprava smatrat će se odustankom od prijma u službu.

Troškove izdavanja uvjerenja o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti snosi Grad (osim u slučaju odustanka kandidata od prijma u službu).

Nakon izbora kandidata, a prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu, provjerit će po službenoj dužnosti postoji li zapreka za prijam u službu zbog pravomoćne osuđivanosti izabranog kandidata za kazneno djelo iz članka 15. ZSN-a te zapreke iz članka 16. ZSNa.

Uredna prijava je ona prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju, u obliku navedenom u natječaju.

Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i njena prijava neće biti razmatrana, te će joj o tome biti dostavljena pisana obavijest. Osoba nema pravo podnošenja pravnog lijeka protiv te obavijesti.

Za kandidate prijavljene na javni natječaj, koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, bit će provedena prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj.

Prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja podnose se u zatvorenim omotnicama na adresu: Grad Umag – Umago, Povjerenstvo za provedbu natječaja, Trg slobode 7, 52470 Umag, u roku od 15 dana od dana objave natječaja u „Narodnim novinama“, s obveznom naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ ZA PRIJAM (upisati naziv radnog mjesta na koji se kandidat prijavljuje) – NE OTVARAJ“.Prijave se mogu neposredno predati i u pisarnicu Grada Umaga – Umago, Trg slobode 7 (prizemlje).

Rješenje o prijmu u službu izabranog kandidata dostavlja se javnom objavom na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga – Umago (www.umag.hr) najkasnije 60 dana od isteka roka za podnošenje prijava na javni natječaj, a dostava se smatra obavljenom istekom osmoga dana od dana javne objave navedenog rješenja.

Opis poslova i podaci o plaći radnog mjesta koje se popunjava ovim natječajem, način obavljanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata, područje provjere te pravni i drugi izvori za pripremanje kandidata za provjeru navedeni su na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga –Umago www.umag.hr (lokacija „Zapošljavanje“).

Na oglasnoj ploči Grada Umaga – Umago i na mrežnoj stranici www.umag.hr (lokacija „Zapošljavanje“) objavit će se vrijeme održavanja prethodne provjere, najmanje pet dana prije održavanja provjere.

URBROJ: 2163-9-03/02-26-1 Vili Bassanese

PROČELNICA

Barbara Krištofić Brenčić, dipl. oec.

Maja Galović, dipl. iur.

I. OPIS POSLOVA

Opis poslova naveden je u Pravilniku o unutarnjem redu gradske uprave („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 9/23., 13/23., 22/23., 5/24., 7/24., 11/24., 16/24., 17/24., 1/25., 7/25. i 7/26.), sistematizaciji radnih mjesta, dostupno na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga – Umago www.umag.hr,

II. PODACI O PLAĆI

Temeljem Pravilnika o radu („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 3/23., 9/23., 22/23., 20/24. i 14/25.), Odluke o koeficijentima za obračun plaće službenika i namještenika („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 2/25., 11/25. i 11/26.) i Odluke o visini osnovice za obračun plaće za službenike i namještenike gradske uprave Grada Umaga – Umago („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 13/25.), osnovna plaća je umnožak koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta na koje je službenik raspoređen i osnovice za obračun plaće u visini od 800 eura bruto, uvećan za 0,5% za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Koeficijent radnog mjesta unutarnjeg revizora iznosi 3,50, stručnog suradnika za isplate - saldakonti 2,60, višeg savjetnika za imovinskopravne poslove 3,50, višeg stručnog suradnika za imovinskopravne poslove 2,70 (uz napomenu da za vrijeme trajanja vježbeničkog staža vježbenik ima pravo na 85% plaće poslova radnog mjesta za koje se osposobljava).

III. PROVJERA ZNANJA I SPOSOBNOSTI KANDIDATA

Za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj, koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete, provest će se prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti, sukladno članku 22. ZSN-a. Prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti kandidata obavlja se putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Smatra se da je kandidat, koji nije pristupio prethodnoj provjeri znanja, povukao prijavu na javni natječaj.

Pravila provjere znanja i sposobnosti

Po dolasku na provjeru znanja, od kandidata će biti zatraženo predočenje odgovarajuće identifikacijske isprave radi utvrđivanja identiteta.

Po utvrđivanju identiteta i svojstva kandidata, kandidatima će biti podijeljena pitanja.

Za svaki dio provjere znanja kandidatima se dodjeljuju bodovi od 1 do 10. Intervju se provodi samo s kandidatima koji su ostvarili najmanje 50% bodova na pisanom testiranju.

Smatra se da je kandidat zadovoljio ako je na intervjuu ostvario najmanje 5 bodova.

Za vrijeme provjere znanja i sposobnosti nije dopušteno:

- koristiti se bilo kakvom literaturom odnosno bilješkama,

- koristiti mobitel ili druga komunikacijska sredstva,

- napuštati prostoriju u kojoj se provjera odvija,

- razgovarati s ostalim kandidatima niti na bilo koji način remetiti koncentraciju kandidata.

Ukoliko pojedini kandidat prekrši naprijed navedena pravila bit će udaljen s provjere znanja, a njegov rezultat Povjerenstvo neće priznati niti ocjenjivati.

Mjesto i vrijeme održavanja provjere znanja i sposobnosti

Mjesto i vrijeme održavanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti, kao i imena kandidata koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, bit će objavljeno na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga – Umago www.umag.hr (lokacija „Zapošljavanje), te na oglasnoj ploči zgrade gradske uprave na adresi Trg slobode 7, prizemlje, najmanje 5 dana prije testiranja.

U Listi kandidata koja će biti objavljena zajedno s vremenom održavanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti, biti će navedeni inicijali kandidata, s godinom rođenja i mjestom prebivališta. Ukoliko se kandidat na koga se ti podaci odnose ne bi mogao identificirati u odnosu na jednake podatke drugog kandidata, dodat će se još jedna značajka koja će ih razlikovati.

II. RETRIBUZIONE MENSILE

Visto il Regolamento di lavoro (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, n. 3/23, 9/23, 22/23, 20/24 e 14/25), vista la Delibera sui coefficienti per il computo degli stipendi per gli impiegati e il personale tecnico (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, nn. 2/25, 11/25 e 11/26), vista la Decisione sulla definizione della base lorda per il computo degli stipendi per gli impiegati e il personale tecnico dell’amministrazione civica della Città di Umag – Umago (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, n. 13/25), lo stipendio base è pari al prodotto tra il coefficiente di complessità dei lavori e la base retributiva (800 euro lordi), con maggiorazione dello 0,5% per ogni anno di anzianità maturato. I coefficienti retributivi per i posti di lavoro di cui al presente Bando sono come segue: revisore interno (3,50); collaboratore professionale pagamenti – saldaconti (2,60); consulente superiore agli affari giuridico-patrimoniali (3,50); collaboratore professionale superiore agli affari giuridico-patrimoniali (2,70 - con la precisazione che, per la durata del tirocinio, il tirocinante ha diritto all'85% dello stipendio previsto per le mansioni del posto di lavoro per il quale si sta formando).

III. VERIFICA DELLE CONOSCENZE E DELLE CAPACITÀ DEI CANDIDATI

In conformità con l'articolo 22 della LIPT, i candidati che intendono partecipare al presente Bando e che soddisfano i requisiti formali stabiliti dallo stesso saranno sottoposti a una verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità dei candidati, la quale consisterà nella prova scritta e nel colloquio di lavoro. Il candidato che non si presenti alla verifica preliminare delle conoscenze e delle capacità sarà considerato aver ritirato la domanda di partecipazione al concorso pubblico.

Regole per lo svolgimento della verifica delle conoscenze e delle capacità

I candidati devono presentarsi alla verifica muniti di un documento di identità valido.

Accertata la loro identità, si procederà alla distribuzione delle domande.

Per ciascuna parte della verifica delle conoscenze ai candidati vengono assegnati da 1 a 10 punti. Il colloquio si svolge esclusivamente con i candidati che abbiano ottenuto almeno il 50% dei punti nella prova scritta. Si considera che il candidato abbia superato il colloquio qualora ottenga un punteggio minimo di 5 punti.

Durante la verifica delle conoscenze e delle capacità non è concesso:

- consultare testi od annotazioni;

- usare il telefono cellulare/smartphone o altri mezzi di telecomunicazione;

- abbandonare il luogo d'esame;

- comunicare con gli altri candidati o disturbarli in altro modo.

jobs.description:
Tražimo komercijalista za rad u prijevozničkoj tvrtki koja se bavi međunarodnim cestovnim prijevozom robe. Radno mjesto je u uredu i nije predviđena mogućnost rada od kuće / remote rada. Osoba na ovom radnom mjestu bit će uključena u svakodnevne komercijalne i administrativne poslove povezane s transportom, vozačima, vozilima, klijentima i poslovnom dokumentacijom. Ključni zadaci i odgovornosti
  • izdavanje i praćenje računa u programu Minimax
  • praćenje uplata i naplata potraživanja
  • priprema naloga za plaćanje i praćenje obveza prema dobavljačima
  • zaprimanje, kontrola i evidencija transportne dokumentacije
  • vođenje i praćenje dokumentacije vezane uz vozila i vozače – dozvole, potvrde, registracije i ostala potrebna dokumentacija
  • komunikacija s klijentima, dobavljačima i poslovnim partnerima telefonskim i elektroničkim putem
  • komunikacija i koordinacija s bankama, Poreznom upravom i drugim državnim institucijama
Uvjeti koje tražimo
  • aktivno znanje engleskog jezika
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu i snalaženje u poslovnim programima i digitalnim alatima
  • dobre organizacijske sposobnosti i pozornost na detalje
  • odgovornost, samostalnost i pouzdanost u radu
  • dobre komunikacijske vještine
  • spremnost na učenje i rad s različitim vrstama poslovne dokumentacije
Prethodno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima, posebno u transportu, logistici, administraciji, računovodstvu ili komercijali, predstavlja prednost. Što nudimo?
  • mogućnost dugoročnog zaposlenja
  • stjecanje praktičnog iskustva u poslovanju međunarodne prijevozničke tvrtke
  • upoznavanje s procesima vezanim uz transport, fakturiranje, naplatu, dokumentaciju vozila i vozača te komunikaciju s klijentima i institucijama
  • mogućnost stjecanja širokog praktičnog znanja iz različitih područja poslovanja
Tražimo osobu koja je organizirana, odgovorna i dobro se snalazi s dokumentacijom, ljudima i računalom te želi naučiti kako funkcionira svakodnevno poslovanje međunarodne prijevozničke tvrtke. Ako se prepoznajete u navedenom, veselimo se vašoj prijavi.

As an Assistant Store Manager, you will support the Store Manager to build a team that delivers results through providing an amazing customer experience. You also share the responsibility to execute all store operations and maintain a visually appealing store. jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

Replit is experiencing extraordinary growth across our customer base and seeking a Mid-Market Account Manager with strong communication skills to drive retention, expansion, and customer success. Candidates with Sales or Account Management experience in SaaS, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.

 

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for customer success and AI. You'll leverage your skills to help customers maximize value from Replit's platform while driving sustainable revenue growth.

 

In this role you will:

 - Execute renewal processes with a focus on expansion and long-term partnership development

 - Serve as the primary relationship owner for your assigned customer portfolio, ensuring high satisfaction and retention

 - Champion customer success by helping businesses realize the transformative potential of AI-powered software creation

 - Lead onboarding programs that accelerate customer time-to-value and platform adoption

 - Guide customers through Replit's rapidly evolving feature set, including Agent 3's autonomous capabilities, Plan Mode, and automation tools

 - Maintain accurate customer health scores and renewal forecasting data in Replit's CRM (Hubspot)

 - Gather and communicate valuable customer feedback, championing their interests within Replit

 - Optimize customers' use of the Replit platform through ongoing training, support, and strategic guidance

 

Required skills and experience:

 - 3-5+ years in a quota-carrying Sales or Account Management role managing a mid-market book in SaaS or developer tools

 - Proven ability to expand product usage while growing your book of business and triaging renewal risk

 - Track record of consistently hitting renewal and expansion targets across a multi-account portfolio

 - Experience blending product-led signals (usage/adoption data) with direct selling

 - Comfort owning a number: forecasting accurately, managing pipeline across dozens of accounts, and closing deals ranging from quick renewals to larger negotiated expansions

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to sell technical value to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Proficiency in using CRM systems and customer success tools (e.g., Hubspot)

 - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies to diverse customer segments

 - Strong problem-solving skills and a consultative approach to uncovering expansion opportunities

 - Passion for AI/automation and staying current with industry trends

 - Comfort with data analysis, especially product usage data, to identify growth signals and prioritize outreach

 

Nice to have:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Experience with rapid prototyping, product development workflows, or business process automation

 - Background in customer success at companies serving technical or semi-technical user bases

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

 

Tools + Tech Stack for this role:

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM

 - Customer success and analytics platforms

 - ZoomInfo

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex

 - Various customer communication and project management tools

 

This role may not be a fit if:

 - You're not passionate about helping customers succeed and driving long-term relationships

 - You lack an understanding of the software development lifecycle or have little interest in learning about technical workflows

 - You're not excited about AI and its potential to transform how businesses operate

 - You don't enjoy being in client-facing roles where 80% of your day is talking to customers

 - You prefer transactional interactions over building deep, strategic relationship

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC office. This role has an in-office requirement.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: GTM Compensation Lead, Commercial Operations
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As our GTM Compensation Lead on Commercial Operations, you’ll own commissions strategy, design, and execution for GTM. This is an opportunity to evolve how GTM Comp supports a growing GTM org through Notion’s AI-era selling motion and Enterprise growth. You’ll set the incentive systems that shape how our sellers focus, partner, and grow with customers. On a typical week, you’ll work with senior GTM leaders — including the Head of Sales and geo leaders — to translate business priorities into clear, accurate, scalable comp programs.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, map the current GTM Comp operating model and publish a roadmap for evolving the function as GTM grows.

 - Introduce AI quick wins that improve the quality of work: triage inbound questions, help reps estimate payouts, flag discrepancies across systems, and automate reminders tied to the comp calendar.

 - Build a planning-cycle framework that makes design inputs, trade-offs, decision rights, and timelines clear across GTM, Finance, and Commercial Operations.

 - Provide board-level updates, including clear reporting on plan health, payout accuracy, systems quality, and key design decisions.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Demonstrated judgment balancing Finance discipline with GTM effectiveness — you can protect accuracy and controls while designing plans that support the selling motion.

 - Strong financial modeling and data fluency, with the ability to translate complex plan mechanics into clear analysis, recommendations, and executive-ready narratives.

 - Experience leading transformative operational projects from design through rollout, especially where cross-functional alignment and change management matter.

 - Track record of building and maintaining sustainable quarterly operating cadences, including clear calendars, communications frameworks, and repeatable review moments. Ideally you have managed this process at a public company.

 - AI-fluent operating style: you use AI to improve decision quality, automate manual checks, identify data discrepancies, and build tools or workflows that make teams more self-serve.

 - Familiarity with Everstage a plus!

jobs.title: Iltapäiväkerhotoiminnan ohjaajan sijainen
jobs.description:
Huvikumpu ry hakee innokasta ja motivoitunutta iltapäivätoiminnan ohjaajan sijaista (2 kpl) täydentämään iloista työtiimiä Porvooseen. Keskuskoululla työskentelevä tiimimme kaipaa reippaita ohjaajan sijaisia paikkaamaan lyhyitä poissaoloja esim sairasloma. Huvikumpu ry järjestää perusopetuksen iltapäivätoimintaa myös Helsingissä kahdella eri koululla.

Meille mieluisa työkaveri olisi lasten kanssa tehtävästä työstä kokemusta omaava, positiivinen ja toimeen tarttuva persoona. Odotamme, että ohjaajan sijaisemme ovat motivoituneita myös ohjaamaan lapsia monipuolisesti mm. erilaisten kädentaitojen ja liikunnan saralla. Järjestämme lapsille mielekästä ohjattua toimintaa päivittäin, mutta toki jätämme tilaa myös leikille sekä vapaalle ulkoilulle. Työ on hyvin monipuolista ja antoisaa. Porvoon yksikön vahvana tukena toimii koordinaattori ja kaksi palveluntuottajaa.

Ohjaajan sijaisen tehtävänä on mm. koululaisten iltapäivätoiminnan suunnittelu, toteutus ja ohjaus yhdessä muun työtiimin kanssa. Tehtäviin kuuluu myös tarvittaessa yhteydenpito sekä yhteistyö niin kouluun kuin vanhempiin. Noudatamme iltapäiväkerhoisamme teemakuukaudet ajattelua sekä viikko-ohjelmaa. Näin takaamme mielekästä ja vaihtelevaa ohjelmaa lapsille. Tärkeä osa laadukasta iltapäiväkerhotoimintaa on ns. maksuton kerhotoiminta, jota suunnittelemme ja toteutamme perheiden sekä lasten toiveiden pohjalta. You will also bridge the gap between customers and internal teams by channeling feedback into product development, ensuring continuous improvement of the platform.

Through scalable enablement strategies, you'll guide customers to maximize platform value and boost satisfaction. Your resources will ensure reliable, exceptional customer outcomes across the board.

jobs.title: Vinduespudser søges
jobs.description:
Bliv vinduespudser hos os – og få et job, der faktisk er fedt at møde op til

Er du træt af kedelige jobs, hvor dagene bare flyder sammen?
Vil du hellere have frihed, ansvar, god løn og et team, du faktisk gider hænge ud med?

Så læs lige videre…..

 

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Du bliver en del af vores team som vinduespudser, hvor du:

  • Arbejder ude hver dag (ingen kontorstol her:) ❌

  • Får ansvar for dine egne opgaver og kunder

  • Kører rundt i din egen firmabil med topmoderne udstyr

  • Leverer kvalitet og god service – og kan se resultatet med det samme

 

Hvem leder vi efter?

Vi søger to typer:

Erfaren vinduespudser

  • Du har min. 3 års erfaring

  • Du ved, hvad du laver – og går op i kvalitet

  • Du vil være en del af et stærkt team og bidrage med din erfaring

Ny i faget (vi lærer dig op)

  • Du har den rette energi og vil lære

  • Vi giver dig en grundig oplæring + bred erfaring

  • Du bliver en del af et team, der faktisk gider hjælpe dig

 

Hvem er du som person?

  • Du er mødestabil og tager ansvar

  • Du har god energi og en positiv attitude

  • Du bidrager til en fed stemning og stærkt fællesskab

  • Du vil ikke bare have et job – du vil være en del af noget

 

Derfor er det her ikke bare et job

Hos os handler det ikke kun om arbejde – det handler om kulturen:

  • Et ungt team med plads til humor og god stemning

  • Sociale aktiviteter, som du selv kan være med til at planlægge

  • Ordnede forhold og respekt for hinanden

  • Et sted hvor man både kan arbejde seriøst – og have det sjovt imens

 

 Hvad får du?

  • Din egen firmabil + det nyeste udstyr på markedet

  • Mulighed for at tjene ekstra:

  • Bonus for at skaffe nye kunder

  • Ekstra indtjening hvis du vil arbejde mere

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Ferie og fridage fra day one

  • Et job hvor du kan udvikle dig og få ansvar

 

Kort sagt:

Hvis du vil have et job med:

  • Frihed

  • God løn

  • Et stærkt fællesskab

  • Og en hverdag du faktisk glæder dig til

…så er det her dit næste job!

 

Klar på at blive en del af holdet?

Send en ansøgning + CV til os i vores link. 

Du skal kunne læse og forstå Dansk eller Engelsk.

Vi ansætter løbende  –  så vent ikke for længe:)

Estimator

Työt alkavat heti!

Keitä olemme?

Ramudden luo kokonaisvaltaisia työturvallisuusratkaisuja tietöihin, rakennuksiin, tiloihin, rautateille ja erilaisiin infrastruktuurin projekteihin. Teemme työmme turvallisesti ja välittäen!

Haemme liikenteenohjaajia useille työmaille pääkaupunkiseudulle! Mitä tarjoamme? Tarjoamme turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön. Liikenteenohjaajan työhön kuuluu varmistaa työmaan läpikulkevan liikenteen turvallinen kulku ja eteneminen niin kauan, kun työmaa on olemassa. Liikenteenohjauksessa työskennellään useimmiten pareittain ja ohjataan liikennettä vuorotellen. Pidämme huolta myös kollegoistamme.

We invite applications for a PhD research position in nuclear reactor control.
The work will be embedded in the SFI - SAINT project Sustainable, Applied and Industrialized Nuclear Technology, which supports the launch of 2-3 nuclear powered demonstration ships in the early 2030s. Within the SAINT project, you will work in Work package 5.

Controlling a nuclear reactor on a ship presents a fundamentally different challenge from controlling a land-based plant. A shipboard reactor must respond to a continuously varying electrical and propulsion load, driven by weather, sea state, maneuvering demands, and onboard consumers, while maintaining safe and stable operation within tight physical and regulatory constraints. This requires integration between the reactor control system and the ship's power management system, coordinating responses across timescales that range from slow thermal transients to rapid load swings during berthing or heavy seas.

In this position, you will develop and implement modern control strategies for a shipboard nuclear reactor, with a primary focus on the interface between reactor output and the ship's overall power demand. This work will be carried out on a nuclear reactor simulator, with the possibility of validating results on a physical non-nuclear test system. You will design control algorithms that handle the full range of operational states, from steady cruising to rapid load changes and emergency scenarios, and ensure that the reactor and ship-side power systems behave as a coherent, stable whole rather than two independently optimised systems.

The position is part of a broader interdisciplinary effort within SAINT, and you will collaborate with researchers working across nuclear engineering, naval architecture, electrical power systems, and maritime operations. The findings are expected to have direct relevance for reactor vendors, shipbuilders, and the regulatory frameworks being developed for maritime nuclear propulsion

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Naval vessels and polar icebreakers have operated on nuclear power for decades. Nuclear propulsion is emerging as a serious candidate for the decarbonization of deep-sea and high-utilisation vessels in Norway and internationally, offering greater energy independence, higher sustained speeds, and extended range compared to conventional fuel-based propulsion. International bodies are actively establishing the frameworks that will govern the civil use of nuclear propulsion and the foundational engineering knowledge is being established right now.

SAINT (Sustainable, Applied and Industrialized Nuclear Technology) is a research project investigating the use of nuclear propulsion for commercial and specialist maritime vessels and aims at launching 2-3 demonstration ships in the early 2030s. SAINT addresses the technical, safety, and operational challenges that must be resolved before such systems can be responsibly deployed. PhD candidates will be among the people shaping this emergent field. In the intersection of nuclear and maritime engineering qualified engineers and researchers are scarce globally. Candidates who complete a PhD within the SAINT project will be well positioned for careers in nuclear safety, maritime regulation, advanced vessel design, and the emerging commercial nuclear sector.

The project is hosted at the Department of Ocean Operations and Civil Engineering (IHB) at NTNU in Ålesund, a campus with deep roots in maritime engineering and ship design. Around 70 PhD students are at NTNU in Ålesund, roughly 40 of which are in IHB working on ship design, naval control systems and in shipping management. Within the project we are aiming to recruit up to ten PhD students and one or two Post Docs to work in parallel across the core engineering challenges of maritime nuclear propulsion, creating an unusually dense and collaborative internal research environment in which you will collaborate with researchers working across nuclear engineering, naval architecture, electrical power systems, and maritime operations.

The project is carried out in close collaboration with thirty industry partners spanning shipbuilders, reactor vendors, turbine manufacturers, control system developers, classification societies, and maritime operators. A dedicated test center for non-nuclear testing of reactor and turbine systems is under construction, giving SAINT researchers hands-on access to hardware validation at a scale rarely available in academic maritime research.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Cooperate with our industrial partners

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in physics, control engineering, electrical engineering, nuclear engineering, mechanical engineering or a closely related field. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme Engineering
  • You must have high proficiency in both written and oral English
  • We can not accept applications of citizens from countries on the OFAC and EAR lists and countries under US arms embargoes as well as heavy restricted/ITAR proscribed countries.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.
The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including classical and modern control design methods
  • Experience with modelling and simulation of dynamic systems
  • Programming proficiency sufficient for implementing and testing control algorithms
  • Experience with nuclear reactor physics and thermal-hydraulics, or reactor simulation tools (e.g. RELAP, TRACE, or MOOSE)
  • Knowledge of electrical power systems and power management, particularly in isolated or islanded grids
  • Familiarity with marine or offshore power systems and their control architectures
  • Knowledge of real-time control systems, embedded systems, or industrial control platforms
  • Familiarity with nuclear regulatory frameworks and the safety requirements imposed on instrumentation and control systems

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

PLEASE NOTE: The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Please note that the person hired will work with critical infrastructure and areas affected by controls on the export of strategic goods, services and technology.


Candidates who do not meet the requirements for the necessary security clearance, access clearance and authorization as described in the National Security Act, and the Act on the Implementation of International Sanctions (Sanctions Act) cannot be considered (e.g., candidates from, among others, Russia, Iran, North Korea, China). Relevant countries are listed as examples and as such the list is not exhaustive (as a result of any changes in the world situation, other countries may be added at short notice).


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Philip Jacob Ferdinand Pfahl, e-mail: philip.j.f.pfahl@ntnu.no 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact PhD Coordinator Lara Bromann, e-mail: lara.bromann@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 4. October 2026.

Start of contract can be flexible, depending on the situation of the candidate.

In this role, you will become a key expert in embedded engine controls and automation systems, supporting customers and productsoperatingworldwide.This is a unique opportunity to combine hands-on troubleshooting, software configuration, field support, testing, and product development while working alongside experts across the global Wärtsilä network.

AtWärtsiläTechnical Services, you will join a highly specialized international team and gain in-depthexpertisein control systems for 4-stroke engines used in both marine and power plant applications.



Your role and responsibilities

As aTechnical Expert, you will play a key role in supporting and developing automation solutions forWärtsilä4-stroke enginesoperatingin marine and power plant applications worldwide.



Your responsibilities will include:

Providing high-level technical support to both internal and external customers remotely and on-site.


Investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving complex automation and control system issues.


Conducting site surveys, commissioning support, and field investigations around the world.


Simulating andanalyzingfield issues in our advanced automation laboratory using physical and virtual test environments.


Performing root cause analyses and supporting product reliability improvements.


Managing engine automation software configurations, upgrades, backups, and system modifications.


Collecting andanalyzingfield feedback, failure statistics, and operational data toidentifyimprovement opportunities.


Preparing technical documentation including service bulletins, manuals, investigation reports, and survey reports.


Initiating, leading, and supporting product and process development projects.


Collaborating with R&D and other technical departments to solve challenging technical problems and enhance product performance.


Supporting product introductions, validation, and testing activities for next-generation automation platforms.


Acting as a technical reference point for product and field-relatedexpertiseacross the organization.




Requirements for the position:

B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Control Systems, or a related field.


Experience in technical troubleshooting and problem-solving.


Experience with embedded control or automation systems.


Strong analytical mindset and systematic approach to technical investigations.


Good communicationskills andproficiencyin English.


Willingness to travel approximately 25% of the time.




It would be great if you also have:

Experience with engine control systems, power generation, marine automation, or industrial automation.


Knowledge of generators, propulsion systems, or energy-related applications.


Experience with software configuration and diagnostics of embedded systems.


Interestin root cause analysis, testing, validation, and product development.


A collaborative mindset combined with curiosity and eagerness to learn.







Contact & next steps

Som Kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

jobs.title: diætist eller ernæringsfaglig profil med stærk træningsfaglighed
jobs.description:
Hos KNAAP arbejder vi med mennesker – ikke bare kostplaner.

Vi hjælper vores klienter med at skabe varige resultater gennem vaner, struktur, træning og forståelse.

Nu søger vi en dygtig og engageret diætist eller ernæringsfaglig profil med stærk træningsfaglighed, som ønsker at arbejde helhedsorienteret med både kost, træning og coaching.

Om stillingen

Som en del af KNAAP får du ansvar for dine egne klienter og følger dem tæt gennem deres forløb.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Kostvejledning og livsstilsforløb

  • Personlig træning

  • Coaching og adfærdsændringer

  • Opbygning af sunde vaner og struktur i hverdagen

Hos os handler et forløb ikke om kost eller træning isoleret. Du skal kunne møde det hele menneske og skabe sammenhæng mellem klientens mål, hverdag, vaner, kost og træning.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er uddannet klinisk diætist, professionsbachelor i ernæring og sundhed eller har en tilsvarende relevant faglig baggrund

  • Har solid erfaring med træning og føler dig tryg i rollen som personlig træner

  • Har stærk træningsfaglig viden og kan omsætte den til praksis

  • Kan skabe et trygt og tillidsfuldt rum for klienterne

  • Har gode coachingevner og forståelse for adfærdsændringer

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og tager ansvar for dine klientforløb

  • Brænder for at gøre en reel og varig forskel i menneskers liv

Vi tilbyder:

  • En fleksibel deltidsstilling på ca. 10–32 timer om ugen

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge dine egne forløb

  • Et fagligt stærkt og moderne setup

  • Et meningsfuldt arbejde med fokus på varige resultater

  • Faglig sparring og mulighed for udvikling

Arbejdet foregår primært i vores center i Valby, og arbejdstiden kan ligge både morgen, eftermiddag og aften. Weekendarbejde kan aftales, hvis det hænger bedre sammen for dig.

Om KNAAP

KNAAP er skabt med en ambition om at gøre op med quick fixes og standardløsninger.

Vi arbejder evidensbaseret med mennesker, vaner, kost og træning, med fokus på at skabe resultater, der fungerer i virkeligheden og holder på lang sigt.

Opstart hurtigst muligt.

Er du interesseret, eller kender du den rette person, så send en mail til kontakt@knaap.dk.

The Child and Family Agency has responsibility for the following range of services: • Child Protection and Welfare • Parenting, Family Support and Early Help Services • Alternative Care • Birth Information & Tracing and Adoption • Tusla Education Support Services (TESS) • Children’s Service Regulation • Counselling and Therapeutic Supports Further information is available on www.tusla.ie Purpose of role: The policy of Tusla Child and Family Agency is to enable children / young people to live with their own families wherever possible and to support parents where necessary in fulfilling that role. The Social Care Worker will provide care, protection, and support to vulnerable or dependent clients, individually or in groups, in conjunction with the wider multidisciplinary team and other relevant agencies. The primary aim is to provide intervention necessary to address the child / young person’s issues or the issues that are preventing them from living at home or in relative / foster care. S/he will ensure the welfare of those under his/her care and will act as an advocate as appropriate. Social Care Workers in a Residential setting work as part of a multidisciplinary team to provide care to service users. Children / young people may be referred to a residential setting for a number of reasons by the Social Work department e.g. family breakdown / separation, history of neglect, sexual / physical abuse, addiction or mental health issues. Residential care aims to provide a therapeutic care placement to service users who most often present with emotional or behavioural difficulties and cannot live with their own families. Applicants must by the closing date of application have the following: Be registered in the Social Care Worker Register maintained by the Social Care Workers Registration Board maintained at CORU (or have entitlement to be registered and obtain registration prior to appointment). Proof of CORU application 5 will be required. AND • Maintain live annual registration on the Social Care Workers Register maintained by the Social Care Workers Registration Board at CORU. AND • Must have the requisite knowledge and ability (including a high standard of suitability and professional ability) for the proper discharge of the duties of the office. Main Duties and Responsibilities Working with Children • To participate in the development and implementation of Care and Placement Plans and to ensure appropriate recording of same • To promote the rights and responsibilities of each child/young person within the centre. • To promote physical, emotional, social and religious welfare of each young person in care. • To encourage attendance at school, training centres, medical and clinical appointments. • To be responsible for the organisation of personal documents, arrangements, information and finance on behalf of the young person. • To liaise with the parent, family, general services and other agencies on behalf of the young person.

Vi søger både dagchauffører og natchauffører.

  • Transport og levering af gods

  • Lastning og losning efter behov

  • Kontrol og korrekt håndtering af gods og fragtpapirer

  • Har gyldigt EU-kvalifikationsbevis/chaufføruddannelsesbevis

  • Har gyldigt førerkort til digital takograf

Arbejdstiderne afhænger af den konkrete rute og aftales nærmere ved ansættelsen. Angiv gerne i din ansøgning, om du foretrækker dag-, nat- eller begge typer kørsel.

  • Fast arbejde og faste ruter

jobs.title: Klar til næste skridt – og har du lyst til at sætte retning for børns sproglige udvikling?
jobs.description:
I Børnehuset Grundtvigsvej søger vi en uddannet pædagog på 37 timer, som brænder for 0-6-årsområdet – og som har interesse for sprog, kommunikation og deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn.

Måske er du allerede sprogvejleder – eller måske drømmer du om at udvikle dig i den retning gennem videreuddannelse og faglig fordybelse.

Uanset hvad søger vi en kollega, der er nysgerrig på, hvordan sprog, leg og relationer hænger sammen med børns trivsel og udvikling.

Om os

Børnehuset Grundtvigsvej rummer 40 børnehavebørn og 24 vuggestuebørn, og vi er et engageret team på 14 medarbejdere, heraf 8 med pædagogfaglig baggrund.

Vi ser os selv som ét fælles hus, hvor alle voksne tager ansvar for alle børn. Derfor arbejder vi tæt sammen på tværs af vuggestue og børnehave, og vi søger en pædagog, der er fleksibel og trives med at være en aktiv del af hele huset.

Hos os er faglig refleksion en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi ved, at børnegrupper og behov forandrer sig, og derfor arbejder vi kontinuerligt med at justere vores praksis og læringsmiljøer, så de understøtter børnenes trivsel, udvikling og deltagelse bedst muligt.

Lige nu er vi særligt optagede af:

  • Legens betydning for udvikling og fællesskaber
  • Deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn
  • Udvikling af inspirerende læringsmiljøer
  • Sprog og kommunikation i hverdagens rutiner, relationer og lege

Vi er samtidig i gang med en spændende udviklingsproces omkring organisering og pædagogisk retning. Derfor søger vi en kollega, som har lyst til at bidrage med idéer, refleksioner og faglige perspektiver.

Vi tilbyder

  • Mulighed for at arbejde målrettet med børns sproglige udvikling og deltagelse
  • Mulighed for videreuddannelse eller kompetenceudvikling inden for sprogvejledning
  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og plads til nye idéer
  • En mentorordning med fokus på tryg opstart og faglig sparring
  • Reel indflydelse på udviklingen af læringsmiljøer og pædagogisk praksis
  • Et stærkt kollegafællesskab med forskellige erfaringer og kompetencer
  • En engageret og opbakkende forældregruppe

Dine kommende kolleger fortæller

Vi er en mangfoldig personalegruppe med forskellige erfaringer, aldre og faglige styrker – fælles for os er passionen for det gode børneliv.

  • Vi elsker vores legeplads og bruger naturen aktivt året rundt.
  • Hver uge laver vi mad over bål sammen med børnene.
  • Fællesfredag er et vigtigt samlingspunkt, hvor store og små mødes på tværs.

Vi drømmer om en pædagog, der

  • Er engageret, nærværende og elsker at være tæt på børnene
  • Har interesse for sprogudvikling, kommunikation og inkluderende læringsmiljøer
  • Måske allerede er sprogvejleder – eller har lyst til at udvikle sig i den retning
  • Kan skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn gennem leg, relationer og hverdagens rutiner
  • Er reflekterende omkring egen praksis og bidrager aktivt til faglige drøftelser
  • Kan tage ansvar og samtidig indgå fleksibelt i fællesskabet
  • Møder børn, forældre og kolleger med glæde, mildhed og empati
  • Har blik for børnenes behov og mod på løbende at justere praksis til gavn for fællesskabet

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så håber vi, du har lyst til at blive en del af Børnehuset Grundtvigsvej og være med til at skabe stærke børnefællesskaber, udviklende læringsmiljøer og gode sproglige muligheder for alle børn.

Ansættelsesdatoen er vi fleksible omkring – for den helt rigtige pædagog til vores hus finder vi gerne den rette startdato.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen
  
Ugentligt timetal: 37

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Katrine Damsgaard Andersen på telefon.


Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.
 
Ansøgningsfrist:  30-09-2026

  
Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.   

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

jobs.title: Salgsprofil med drive søges til Jørgen Hansen Biler i Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Har du de hurtige sko på, tager du initiativ og sætter du kundens behov først? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Hos Jørgen Hansen Biler søger vi en energisk og målrettet kollega til vores salgsafdeling i Esbjerg. Du bliver en del af et ungt team, hvor der er højt til loftet, godt humør og fart over feltet. I Esbjerg arbejder vi med Kia og MG, og du får derfor mulighed for at arbejde med to stærke bilmærker i en branche, hvor udviklingen går stærkt – ikke mindst inden for elektrificering og ny teknologi.

Vi leder efter dig, der har drive, tager initiativ og har lyst til at lære. Dig, der får ting til at ske, følger op på dine kunder og ikke er bange for at tage fat. Som en del af salgsteamet bliver du en vigtig del af hele kunderejsen – fra den første henvendelse til bilen bliver afleveret til kunden.

Arbejdstiden ligger både på hverdage og i weekender, da vores kunder også skal kunne møde os, når de har fri. Du skal derfor være indstillet på weekendvagter som en naturlig del af jobbet.

Din hverdag kommer blandt andet til at bestå af:

  • Assistere sælgere med praktiske opgaver

  • Praktiske opgaver i udstillingen og opsætning af udstilling, herunder at sørge for, at priser, lister og skilte er opdateret

  • Sikre, at demobiler er klar til prøvekørsel

  • Sidemandsoplæring

  • Kundekontakt i butikken, på telefon og digitalt

  • Rådgivning af kunder om deres næste bil

  • Opfølgning på kundehenvendelser og leads

  • Annoncering og præsentation af biler online

  • Oprettelse og opdatering i vores salgs- og CRM-systemer

  • Opfølgning på aftaler og igangværende salg

Vi arbejder struktureret med salget, men der er samtidig plads til, at du kan sætte dit eget præg på hverdagen.

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • Er initiativrig og tager ansvar for dine egne opgaver

  • Har interesse for biler og lyst til at lære

  • Er målrettet og motiveres af at skabe resultater

  • Har drive og masser af energi

  • Har de hurtige sko på og følger hurtigt op på kunder

  • Er god til mennesker og trives med kundekontakt

  • Sætter kundens behov først

  • Har ordenssans og kan holde styr på dine aftaler og opgaver

  • Har kørekort til personbil

Det vigtigste er, at du har lysten og engagementet. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring i vores biler, systemer og salgsprocesser.

Bliv en del af et ungt team
Du bliver en del af et ungt og engageret salgsteam i Esbjerg, hvor vi arbejder sammen, hjælper hinanden og har ambitioner om at skabe gode resultater.

Vi tror på, at ansvar og udvikling går hånd i hånd. Derfor får du ansvar fra starten og mulighed for at udvikle dig i takt med dine evner og ambitioner.

Vi tilbyder

  • En arbejdsplads i vækst med Kia og MG, og et stort udvalg af biler

  • En spændende hverdag i et ungt og dynamisk team

  • Grundig oplæring i salg, biler og vores systemer

  • Mulighed for mere ansvar i takt med din udvikling

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Attraktiv lønpakke

  • Pension og sundhedsforsikring

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og indkalder til samtaler, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Send din ansøgning samt CV til ts@jh-biler.dk med emnefeltet “Salgsprofil”. Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: SALGSSPECIALIST TIL ENTREPRENØRMASKINER – JYLLAND & FYN
jobs.description:
Kan du åbne nye døre, skabe relationen og lukke salget?

På vegne af Dansk Maskincenter A/S søger SelectioPlus en erfaren og resultatorienteret salgsspecialist, der skal være med til at udvikle Dansk Maskincenters salg inden for entreprenørsegmentet i Jylland og på Fyn – med Develon som en central del af sortimentet.

Dansk Maskincenter har et bredt sortiment af maskiner og løsninger til markedet. Develon er det senest tilkomne brand inden for entreprenørmaskiner og udgør en central del af ambitionen om at styrke virksomhedens position i entreprenørsegmentet.

Derfor leder vi ikke efter en sælger, der primært skal passe en eksisterende kundeportefølje. Vi søger en hunterprofil, som kender entreprenørbranchen, forstår markedet og motiveres af at opsøge nye kunder, skabe muligheder og omsætte dem til konkrete handler.

Du får stor frihed til at drive dit marked – og samtidig meget tydelige forventninger til resultaterne.

OPGAVEN

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe vækst i Dansk Maskincenters salg inden for entreprenørsegmentet – med Develon som en central del af sortimentet.

Du skal aktivt ud i markedet og opbygge relationer til både nye og eksisterende kunder i Jylland og på Fyn. Det kræver, at du trives med den opsøgende del af salget og selv tager initiativ til at finde de næste muligheder.

Dine centrale opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

·       opsøge og udvikle nye kunder

·       sælge entreprenørmaskiner fra Dansk Maskincenters sortiment til nye og eksisterende kunder

·       identificere nye salgsmuligheder i markedet

·       følge mulighederne hele vejen fra første kontakt til afsluttet handel

·       rådgive kunderne og finde den rigtige løsning til deres behov

·       sikre høj aktivitet og en stærk pipeline

·       deltage på relevante messer, kundearrangementer og møder

·       bidrage praktisk, når det er nødvendigt – her hjælper man hinanden

Det afgørende er ikke, at du er den mest administrative sælger i branchen. Det afgørende er, at du kan skabe salg og afslutte handler.

HVEM ER DU?

Vi forestiller os, at du allerede kender entreprenørbranchen og har erfaring med salg i markedet.

Du har minimum tre års salgserfaring – gerne fem år eller mere – og du ved, hvad der skal til for at skabe en kundeportefølje og holde momentum i et salgsområde.

Din konkrete uddannelsesbaggrund er mindre vigtig. Erfaring, branchekendskab og dokumenterede salgsresultater vejer tungere.

Som person er du udadvendt og kontaktskabende. Du får energi af at være ude hos kunderne og er ikke afhængig af, at leads og muligheder kommer til dig.

Du er selvkørende, resultatorienteret og vedholdende. Og når muligheden er der, har du både lysten og evnen til at bede om ordren og få handlen afsluttet.

Samtidig skal du være ordentlig. Dansk Maskincenter ønsker langsigtede kunderelationer, så resultater skal skabes med troværdighed, empati og respekt for kunden.

Du taler og skriver dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk.

DER ER KLARE FORVENTNINGER

Du kommer ind i en stilling, hvor succes kan måles.

Efter de første tre måneder er ambitionen, at du har opbygget en reel pipeline med omkring 24 tilbud og har solgt de første tre maskiner.

Efter seks måneder er målet omkring otte solgte maskiner.

Efter 12 måneder er ambitionen et salg på cirka 15 mio. kr., samtidig med at det brugte lager løbende bliver omsat.

Tallene fortæller noget vigtigt om stillingen: Det her er en salgsrolle.

Du bliver ansat til at skabe aktivitet, nye kunder og resultater – og du får samtidig friheden til selv at finde vejen derhen.

STOR FRIHED I HVERDAGEN

Salgsområdet er Jylland og Fyn, og derfor er det oplagt, at du bor et sted i dette område.

Du behøver ikke bo tæt på Dansk Maskincenters hovedkontor. Du får mulighed for at have kontor på en af virksomhedens lokationer og kan også arbejde hjemmefra.

Du tilrettelægger i høj grad selv din hverdag og dine kundebesøg. Den normale arbejdstid ligger omkring kl. 8.00-16.00, men jobbet kræver naturligvis fleksibilitet i forbindelse med messer, kundemøder og andre relevante aktiviteter.

DU BLIVER EN DEL AF DANSK MASKINCENTER

Dansk Maskincenter A/S er en moderne maskinforretning med afdelinger i Jelling, Odder, Rimmerhus og Toftlund og omkring 87 engagerede medarbejdere.

Virksomheden sælger blandt andet traktorer, høstmaskiner, redskaber, plæneklippere, mindre maskiner og Develon entreprenørmaskiner. På alle lokationer understøttes kunderne desuden af reservedelssalg og egne værksteder.

Det giver dig en organisation i ryggen, som kan understøtte både salget og kunderne efter handlen.

Kulturen er flad og uformel med højt til loftet, god energi og humor. Der er frihed under ansvar – men også forventning om, at du tager ejerskab for dit område og dine resultater.

VI TILBYDER

Du tilbydes en fast fuldtidsstilling med en månedlig grundløn, afhængigt af kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Herudover tilbydes pension, sundhedsforsikring, fri telefon og firmabil.

Der er ikke bonusordning knyttet til stillingen. Til gengæld får du stor selvstændighed og mulighed for at få en central rolle i udviklingen af Dansk Maskincenters forretning inden for entreprenørsegmentet.

Tiltrædelse ønskes hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

INTERESSERET?

Rekrutteringen gennemføres af SelectioPlus på vegne af Dansk Maskincenter A/S.

Send dit CV og gerne en kort motivation til:

Henrik Sødequist
Headhunter & Managing Partner, SelectioPlus
hs@selectioplus.dk

Vi indkalder relevante kandidater løbende og afslutter processen, når det rette match er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du også meget velkommen til at kontakte Henrik Sødequist.

jobs.title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
jobs.description:
Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:

At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations.

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects.

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team.

About the role

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value.

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work.

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems
  • Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities
  • Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness
  • Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs)
  • Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures
  • Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments
  • Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships

What you bring

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value:

  • Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies
  • Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers
  • Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects

Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued):

  • Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement
  • Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces
  • Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management

In addition, you bring:

  • Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
  • A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
  • Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
  • Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
  • Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition

The team you will join

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.

What we offer

  • A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company
  • Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations
  • A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues
  • A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning
  • Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.


About BeGreen

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities.

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets.

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.
